reviewsWithKeywords.title: One of the best resorts FOR ADULTS ONLY
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The Royalton may be a bit "weathered", after all, it used to be the "Sandals" however a lot of the personnel of that era are still there.However, the food selection as well as the quality of services provided, and the peronnel who go out of their way to solve the few issues you could have while a guest there, make it one of the best (if not the best) on the Island.. This year will be our 13th visit, for 2 weeks as usual. Apart from the pandemic, where almost no one travelled there from Canada, guest rarely have any type of food shortage. Best travel time is mid April to mid October. After that, you hit the bad weather season (Hurricanes) although Varadero has only been hit once, since we travel there, and besides an enormous amount of rain and a few straw coverings of the main lobby bar's roof, nothing elese was damaged. Note that this hotel was one of the very few who has highly powerful and efficient Generators that can supply all the AC each group of rooms,(400) dstributed in the various building. Tip..condiments like Ketchup, French Mustard (high quality) and Tabasco Sauce are not always available. BYO  Bring Your Own.  Noteworthy to mention that this is an Adult only resort, no children. You must be 18 (used to be 21).Make sure that if you like to enjoy the free alcohol that you do not become raudy or agressive. If you do, you will get a warning from security. If you fight, on the premises, amoung yourselves of with another guest, or damage hotel property, YOU WILL BE KICKED OUT and BANNED FROM FURTHER TRAVEL TO CUBA. They do not joke in Cuba about those things, and, don't forget, it is the Millitary that enforce the rules if there is bad behaviour. They will kick you out and forget about refunds. You also may spend the remaining of your holiday in a Cuban cell (Jail or Prison) depending on the offense. Safe and enjoyable travel to all. We leave today !! :-)

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Shhhhhh ... .
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Lets begin by remembering Cuba is still under embargo, and suffers mightily for it, so a trip here is for folks already familiar w and as flexible as a 'backpacker'.  Still worth 'the hassle'?  Absolutely.  An amazing getaway.  Arguably one of the best, if not the best, North Amercian beach.  Including many islands and places further S.  Beach itself is not much for shells, but amazing for walking.  And swimming?  The water is clearest ocean outside of SE Asia - Indian Ocean.  Healthy.  and w great coral once you get a bit further out (and bit further under).  Water is so much clearer and cleaner than FL - Gulf Coast.  I.E.  when departing - flying to S Florida take a look out the plane.  The brown water ring around FL starts about 10 - 12 miles out.  Depart FL & fly into Havana.  Look at water on approach.  Yeah.  Blue.  And Varadero is 60 - 90 minutes further E.  An absolute pleasure.  Worth the visit.  (Havana is its own great trip for the intrepid.  Amazing food, art, music).

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beaches treated as landfills
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The ocean in front of you is simply wonderful and enchanting. Beaches, however, treated as waste dumps by those who frequent them: Cigarette butts by the hundreds put out in the sand, plastic bags, cans, snack wrappers and empty plastic drink bottles abandoned on the sand. Palm leaf umbrellas left without managers. Trash containers that are never emptied. The few managers present in some areas, take care of their few meters of beach. The rest is left to decay and neglect. No control by local authorities to prevent and sanction this uncivilised and environmentally damaging behaviour. No initiative to encourage virtuous behavior. Really demeaning to see that no one here cares about the future of their natural environment, which remains magnificent despite the destructive power of the human being.

Varadero beach is lined with resorts that offer a wide range of services and amenities, making it an ideal destination for both families and couples. reviewsWithKeywords.title: Ok for two days of rest but no more
reviewsWithKeywords.text: If you have many, many days of vacation it is worth spending two days in Varadero to appreciate another side of Cuba. A country entirely designed for tourists, an empty plastic container, with a kilometre-long beach (beautiful and with a crystal clear sea and with lots of free beach space outside the resorts, cheap umbrellas and deckchairs nothing to say) but nothing more. Empty shops and restaurants without a minimum of authenticity. The only positive note is that it is possible to visit this tourist destination using the casas particulares in the first part of the peninsula, avoid the resorts that I have only heard bad things about (some told us they lacked hot water and even toilet paper). The only other activity that we found valid is free scuba diving which allows you to dive safely. For the rest Varadero is not Cuba! ok two days of rest after a long trip to the real Cuba

The resort is so nicely kept, the beds are comfortable, the beach is so beautiful, and the pool was pristine. Bar staff were INCREDIBLE and did their best to find a drink you would like. There was no shortage of draft beer, no canned beer, no sodas. There was a lack of nighttime entertainment, but the staff kept things fun during the day. We will return to Cuba, but we are going to explore other resorts. We were disappointed that we weren't recognized as repeat guests. :(

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Dirty beach front at Meliá Peninsula Veradero hotel.
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The beach is over rated!  Yes, the water is pretty blues, but the shore is sharp w broken shells and tiny rocks. Once you get past that, it’s sandy. This time of year, the beach is infested with Portuguese man O’ war. I was stung, so there’s that. The water was also chilly and quite high waves. It was yellow or red flags most days. When it was green flag, the waters were beautifully calm, but I still saw jelly sacs floating around, so I got out of there!  I guess depending on where you stay, the beach may or may not be clean. The sargassum is very smelly. Also, many tourists are quite dirty, leaving their cigarette butts, plastic cups and other trash dumped around.  I stayed at the Meliá Peninsula Veradero AI resort. It wasn’t a great experience. Maybe other resorts clean the beach front, but this one does not. I’ll be glad to get home tomorrow.

The whole group at the pool bar - Disney, Rene, Alex and Julio were friendly and quick with refills.  At the buffet, Melissa, Reinier, Rigoberto and Arelys were always keeping busy and we had what we needed.  Duniel at the beach bar always greeted us with a smile and small talk.  And the team in the lobby always worked well with each other helping each other and taking time to talk with the customers.  Leidy, Mabel, Darlay, Yohamel, Louis, Niurkis, Beatriz and Michel were always attentive and had a warm greeting each time we saw them.  Danai always had a great smile on her face and remembered us from a previous visit.  And Coca whenever he saw us always asked how we are doing and if everything is alright.And then there's Dayan, the fellow who would exchange the beach towels if there were any.  He always had a smile on his face and had plenty of time to talk with us.This was one of our better visits here.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Paradisus Rio De Oro Resort & Spa Pros and Cons
reviewsWithKeywords.text: I visited Paradisus Rio De Oro Resort & Spa hotel with the group of friends from August 22-29, 2023.This was my 1-st visit and the last one.    It is nice property but the beach in common section is pretty small and the part of it is rocky. During my stay there were not many visitors (I never saw such an empty hotel before) so you always could find the place in the shade or under the sun.    The service was pretty good. My room request was granted and I had the room on the 2-nd floor in the building close to the lobby. The stairs in the room have to be marked for safety reasons as at night people could fall.    The main concern here was the food (breakfast) and the entertainment.  Not too many options for the breakfast, even the eggs were not there for 2 days and the cooks had to use the egg powderinstead. The cheeses and cold meats variety were very poor. Even the crusted bread which is usually so good in Cuba was not there.The vegetables selection was almost non-existent: shredded carrots, beets, cucumber, corn (from can) and mushrooms (from can). As for fruits the guests could choose from guava, watermelon, papaya and mango. I've never had such sweet and juicy mango as in Paradises, papaya and watermelon were also good. The banana smoothie which is very delicious in Cuba could not be prepared as bananas were missing. Also Pina Colada and Mojito could not be prepared most of the time because of the ingredients shortages.  Brandy, Gin, Cognac, Ron, Whiskey, Vermouth and beer were always in the bar. Coffee was pretty good too.    Because of the small number of guests the main buffet was working mostly for the breakfast we were given opportunity to visit the restaurants for the dinner and this was very good choice as all the restaurants had good menu with sea food and beef/pork/chicken which were delicious and presented in a nice manner. We visited El Patio, Mediterraneo, Tsuru and Los Helechos. I would recommend to visit all of them if possible. We dined at the main buffet twice and the variety was good and plentiful. The ice-cream was very delicious too.   One dinner was set close to the pool and the pool show followed. The dinner was delicious and the show beautiful and very professional. In 1 week we saw 3 shows only and in the evening guests were pretty bored.Overall this was not bad experience but the price/quality ratio was not the best here. It is for sure not 5 *hotel even by Cuban ranking. I paid around $1380 for the single and for CAD $200-$300 cheaper could have the same experience in other 4-4.5 * Cuba hotels.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: What you need to know about Cuba before departure
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The 13-hour flight was endured quite calmly; to switch to the current time zone, I had Melaxen with me, an ideal solution in such cases. We arrived calmly, the plane was huge, there were a lot of people, we were fed twice. Directly at Varadero airport everything was very fast, then we waited a long time until everyone got ready for the transfer, about 1.5 hours, but many took a taxi.And here I am at the base, with plans to go to bed after dinner and go to the sea in the morning. On the way I meet 2 Russian ladies who say that we should go to the sea right now. And I went. It was about 8 o'clock on the clock, I immediately died from the sunset, it was incredibly beautiful. And then she ran into the water shouting hurray. I’ll look at you when you don’t go anywhere further than Crimea for 7 years 😁 And, it would seem, what could be wrong. But I'm Masha. This means that on the way back from the beach, sand or a shell, or whatever, will hit my slap, but it will tear my leg to pieces right on the foot at the junction of the middle toe. As a result, the next 2 days will be spent in hysterics and searching for antibiotics and antibiotic ointments, because the post-Covid tourist named after me will take everything with him except this. Hysteria, snot tears, non-healing leg. I find chats in the cart of vacationers in Varadero, some guy gives me an antibacterial spray, some man is carrying an antibiotic, a remedy for fungus (because I didn’t understand what it was at first) and a patch for wet calluses from Russia. I offer money for all this, but they don’t take it, even paying for taxi delivery😅 I call the insurance company, no, I didn’t mistype it, because it’s not health insurance, it’s fucked up. Get treatment there at your own expense, and then apply for compensation in Russia. What is the bill, how much is it? There are pharmacies here that don't have anything. There are no medicines on sale here at all; the country is very poor.The security guard at the reception talks about the doctor at the hotel. I'm crying because I'm a girl and I'm scared. Somehow I fall asleep. In the morning I go to her and oh, miracle, she has everything I need. She treats the wound. By the evening, in combination with the guy’s spray, my leg begins to go away, I fall asleep normally for the first time in almost 4 days.Summary:•Bring really ALL medications with you•Make insurance separately from the tour and check the conditions•Find hotel chats and fellow travelers’ chats in advance for really cool excursions at reasonable prices, not like those from a tour operator* Take a hotel with medical staff*And Wi-Fi is not available everywhere. In Melia las antillas there is, in Barcelo solymar it is bad, although it is 5*, and in some 4* there was no Internet either.What else can I say: It's awesome here. Unless you are Masha. If Masha is also awesome, upgrade the option: what to do if 3.14zdets happened)

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Excellent stayiing in Varadero, Cuba
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Always Choose an All Inclusive Hotel in CUBA, because it could be difficult to go by yourself to a restaurant. Sometimes they do not accept your dollars or your credit card, and -I know it is surprising- they do not accept even the Cuban Peso!!! Some places only accept the Cuban credit Card, reserved for locals!!!we stay stayed in Melia, and it was sensational!! DO get the tour: catamaran with Dolphins. Exceptional !! Try to get a flight from your country to VARADERO and NO HAVANA. !! Stay at least 4 nights in Varadero. From Varadero pick one or 2  full days to visit Havana WITH A GUIDE.  CUBA is VERY safe, BUT locals bother you all the time.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Not sure we will go back unless maybe on a Monday.
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This place is suppose to be the Jewel Beach area of Cuba…. ReallyMaybe only at the resorts.I rented a house there, one block from the beach, for myself, my wife, and all her family.The town its self was ok, you can tell the economy is hurting there, which is sad. Not a lot of tourist did I see, but lots of people over the weekend. Thank goodness we brought all our own food and Beer. There was not a single beer for sale in all of Varadero, except the one place we found that had beer, you had to order an entree and then you could buy 2. No more.I also have to say the sand and water at the beach were indeed beautiful; however, there were mountains of trash everywhere. Visitors to the beaches actually just throw all their trash on the ground like they have zero manners for others or our planet. But Thank God there came tractors and people on Mondays to pick what they saw all up. What I did not understand was there are actually trash cans and dumpster there and were empty…I think we will look for a less popular beach destination in Cuba for our next visit.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Excellent 9 Days at the Sanctuary

The Sanctuary Restaurant - Breakfast and Dinner - excellent meals. Chef Enzo (Vincenzo) always provided us with delicious meals. reviewsWithKeywords.text: Sand,  mostly clear water, modest waves.Long, many miles to walk.Local salesmen bother just a little.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Turquoise waters await
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beautiful turquoise water and soft sands are along the shores of Varadero Beach.   Hotel beaches are wonderful but the public beaches in town also have a charm of their own. A great place to relax in the calm morning waters or play in the waves in the afternoon.  It is my go-to for warm weather fun.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: The best beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Sandy shallow beach, warm water, although I have known this from prior visits. When I want to enjoy the beach during the Canadian winter I go to Varadero

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Calm water when no wind. Shallow water and safe for children. Beach bar all inclusive for Meliá guests.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Varadero the beautiful
reviewsWithKeywords.text: I was thinking that the Clearwater Beach was the best. But I was wrong. Veracero is the best of  The whole world .

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Good time to travel
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Happy to say Beaches were mostly empty now which makes social distancing easy. So glad I went. My 10 year old loved it too.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Slice of paradise
reviewsWithKeywords.text: You can’t fault this beach!Soft white sand,gently shelving and very suitable for young children.Shells are gorgeous along this strip and we found loads of sand dollars.loved watching the crabs pop up and down into the holes.We had a few red flag days during our stay but jumping the waves was huge fun!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Stunning beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The beach at Varadero is stunning.  It is postcard perfect with soft white sand, stunning clear warm water that you can walk quite a way out in. Fabulous!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Sol palmeras 2020
reviewsWithKeywords.text: It is a clean beach with few people. Quite calm and very pretty. The sand is fine and white, in these months it has a little more waves.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Long beach perfect for walks
reviewsWithKeywords.text: So beautiful, you can walk for hours and when we went in November we watched the sunsets every night!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beach is clean and pretty but little to do
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The beach is beautiful, but little to do, the hotel don’t let you take the sailing boats out on your own like they do on other Caribbean bean islands. No bars or clubs on the beach, Just sand and sea and yourselves. Great for hermit crabs and general crabs.. lots of good wildlife.other beaches on the island were a lot better. Bay of pigs highly recommended.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: As good as it gets
reviewsWithKeywords.text: One word to describe this beach Breathtaking. It is what you envisage when thinking about a Caribbean  Beach, which this one is no exception. Rated here on TripAdvisor in the top 5 beaches in the world and from what we saw well deserved, the sand is soft and the water crystal clear, light blue, warm and super inviting. We were fortunate that the beach is also manned by the resort security which meant that the guests had the whole beach to themselves which made it an even more enjoyable experience. It is just like the postcards and the TV advertising shows. Photos & footage do not do it justice seeing it in real life is the ultimate experience. We spent a lot of the time in the water as it was so warm clean and refreshing as the sun was super hot. The resort provided  plenty of deck chairs that reclined and also large umbrellas to shade you from the sun but the heat still made the water a Great Escape and a real relief to which you found it hard to leave behind.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Boring with no charm!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The sea and beach is beautiful enough, but a bit boring. There is absolutely nowhere to sit down and eat or drink with a sea view if you don’t live on an all inclusive hotel by the sea front. We thought it was ridicolous. We stayed less than 24 hour and moved on to a more beautiful and interesting place!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Ah, the Beautiful Beach!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This is why we came to Cuba. Sit on the beach, take in the sun, and play in the water. We were here in mid-February. The water was warm, the sun was hot, it was great. Oh, one day it was closed for jellyfish, but the lifeguards were letting people know, and keeping us safe. We were on the beach near our hotel, and it was just amazing!  I can't wait to go back next year!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: beautiful
reviewsWithKeywords.text: the best beaches, the water is cristalline and you can see the pieces, when it's windy its better not to get in, because of the waves.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: The best!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Been to Veradero 8 times, the beach is spectacular. Was due to leave tomorrow, obviously not happening now, but hoping for next year. White sand for miles, turquoise water, perfection..

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful blue beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Thank goodness we found the beach pretty quiet for a populated tourist hub. Water was the bluest I’ve ever seen and the sand was powered white. Shady areas go quick so plan to be in the sun or a cafe/bar. Gorgeous spot one block away and parallel to main road. An easy and interesting walk.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: One of the best beaches in the world
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This really is one of the nicest tourist beaches in the world. It's consistently nice and sandy along the whole strip, shallow, friendly to swimming, and just looks beautiful.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Most beautiul beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This is one of the most beautiful beaches in the whole world. It is very clear, with bright color, white and soft sand. It is ideal for travelling any time of the year, with family or friends

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful Beach!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Gorgeous beach- one of the best I've ever seen... lifeguards on duty- listen to them! Water is so clear and blue...

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Vacation
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The beaches were not very clean And the people were not very friendly in the city of Cuba Varadero  I was very disappointed with you but this time around the last time I went to Cuba last year the people were more friendly but this year the people were not very friendly

reviewsWithKeywords.title: The best beach I have ever been to
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beautiful white sand blue sea. Nice sun beds and lovely lifeguards. The snack bar had great cuban sandwiches I can’t wait to go back

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Best beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The best beach with clean and clear water soft white sand and beautiful sunsets. Please bring a reusable cup to cut down on plastic waste.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful walkable beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: So shallow and turquoise, our hotel held many activities here to enjoy, quite flat and easy to walk.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Miles of white sand beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The Varadero beach is superb!  Miles of white sand stretch before you leading you into the warm and usually calm Caribbean Sea.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: One of the best beach in the Carribean
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Cooler and winder some days in the winter months of Jan, Feb, March, this beach is a wonderful paradise year long.  Long walks on white sand!  I am however disappointed in the continuous use of plastic cups and straws from the majority of Cuban hotels.This beach is wonderful to take long swims as well.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful white sand beaches!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Loved the beach, the sun and the warm weather. Not a fan of Varadero though. I've been to so many other lovely places in Cuba that Varadero just doesn't do it for me anymore. By far the best beach is in Cayo Coco, the best vacation spot for me is Guardalavaca beach in Holguin. Cayo Largo is an isolated island and not a place I would go to again. Cayo Santa Maria is gorgeous but windy. Havana is great for a day visit if you're in Varadero but I personally wouldn't stay overnight. Hotels that are internationally owned in partnership with Cuba have a much better selection of food so keep that in mind.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Sand, sea and sky
reviewsWithKeywords.text: There are two parts to Varadero, the old town and the new town where there are many modern beach resorts which make the most of this beautiful location.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beach of my dream
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beautiful color, white sand, clean water. Long enough for long walks on the shore. Not too deep to go to swim. Quiet, not crowded. Almost perfect!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beaches here are SO beautiful! If I could just live on the beach for my entire sty it’s beautiful wether I would have been happy.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Great beach warm sea
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Was a lovely place to visit. Silky soft sand and the sea was warm and calm. Our hotel was right on the beach so we had waiter service for cold drinks...all amazing

reviewsWithKeywords.title: One of the most beautiful beaches in the world, bar none
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Stayed at the Blau Hotel resort and truly enjoyed the beach in Varadero. Third time in the area and never get tired of the soft sand, wide beach, beautiful water,  all on hand and available. Can’t ask for more

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Nice sunny days
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Nice long beach. Sea water was great, and it wasn’t windy. So it was nice to be on beach all day. You have places were to hide from sun and drink some nice cocktails.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Town of veradero
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We were able to take the hop on and off bus for 5 cuc per person . It was a very cheap way to travel from the resort to the town . We enjoyed the view . You can hop on and off all day long. If you get a chance stop at the small market we liked shopping there more then the big market . The big market we found the sales people a little pushy. However there is a street vendor selling awsome coconut runs and piña Clauda . If you get a chance stop at the all Capone mansion . It was cool to see and free . The beach outside there was amazing with a guy feeding pelicans . So cool . Just be aware of the horse and buggy ride. We were cautious of this because we heard the stories of people getting screwed but we talked about how much before we got on but when we got off omg the price was different . 80 cuc for the four of us holy cow we were originally told 10 . So be warned

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Fres and clean beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Very clean with clean water. A wonderful beach with offers of pedal boats, cano rent and small sail boats. Relaxing for singles and families.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Rated as one of top ten beaches in the world.
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We stayed nearby At Arenas Doradas which has access to the beach.  The sand is a gorgeous colour.  Many of the pictures of swaying palms, uncrowded, do not reflect the reality.  Each hotel has staked out a section and there is wall to wall beach reclining chairs.   You will be approached by locals selling stuff but they are not aggresive as in Mexico, nor do they come right in among the tourists.  Most hotels have a staff of security down on the beach.This area has rip tides and the caution flags were flown all the week we were there.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Labranda Resorts
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Clear Blue Water , White Sandy Beaches! Really enjoyed swimming in the ocean, water was warm and inviting.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Quiet and Wonderful
reviewsWithKeywords.text: When we were at this beach, I was amazing at how quiet it was. There were only about 1 dozen people on the beach or in the water, with the odd visit from people who were curious and just came to check it out. There were no services that I could see, except if we were to go off the beach to the streets. The beach was clean and well-kept.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Amazing beach!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: I couldn’t fault the beach in any way. It was perfect, with the best sunset at the end of the day. Couldn’t have been any better to be honest.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Best beaches
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Can't get enough of these beaches.just beautiful.always clean and well kept.will return every time get the urge for some sun.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Varadero Beah
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Varadero beach is fantastic! You can walk for miles on the beautiful white sand. Excellent! Most resorts along the peninsula have this beach.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Most beautiful beach in the world
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Every time  I come back I'm never disappointed in this beach. I never get over the turquoise color of the ocean or the beautiful white sand of the beach.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Clean and beautiful
reviewsWithKeywords.text: There is a reason this is one of the most beautiful beaches in the world.  It has life guards . It is soft sand and graded for flotsam and jetsom on a daily basis.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: 22 kilometers white sandy beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Whats not to like,about the beach all swimable.Gorgeous blue green water clean and clear.However because the Cubans have not been taught to recycle bottles&cans you see it on the beach.I gather what i can ,lay it in the middle of beach gets picked up by a grater that cleans in the morning.Returning is now in effect and you can be fined but this is quite new.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Diamond Club beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Terrific. And staff is friendly. Own private area on the beach. Water was a tad chilly but I went for the sun.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Holiday
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beautiful place a must visit for your bucket list!!! The beech is cleaned daily and a tractor rakes it , gorgeous warm sea , we stayed at the Blau hotel so right on the beech ...... amazing place , Cuba needs tourist badly , please visit you will not be disappointed.....

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: My husband and I revisited Cuba after many years. The beach is still as beautiful as ever. As a non swimmer, I felt xo for table going into the water as it is quite shallow and not a lot of undertow. The sand is white and soft. I will definitely go back for the water, sand and sun.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Most amazing beach!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The beach is what keeps us coming back to Cuba each year. That beautiful turquoise color and white sand. Love how clear the water is with no rocks and rarely any seaweed.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beauty...
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Varadero's beach is absolutely beautiful and I don't think you could ever get tired of it.  We saw it at sunrise, sunset, during calm and during stormy times, and it was awesome every time.  Water is crystal clear.  The sand right at the shore is on an angle, so walking along the shore is a bit awkward.  The sand in general is deep, so it's a workout to walk for a long stretch, but still worth every second.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Varadero Beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beautiful long beach...can be quite windy, be careful of jellyfish on really windy days. Never crowded.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Varadero Beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Fourth time there  never lets us down , great beaches.  Prefer staying at south end walking distance  of the stripand Santa Marta .

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beaches are clean
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Some of the best beaches down south. Water is warm and beaches usually cleaned every day . So nice to walk and explore

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: A beautiful beach spoilt by tourists.  San and blue seas but an opportunity for water sports.  There is a beach bar and many sun loungers but ca be noisy with music but this is Cuba

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Gorgeous beach and clear water
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This has got to be one of the best beaches I've ever walked on. The sand is white and free of debris with very little sea weed or rocks. Perfect for swimming.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Best beach ever
reviewsWithKeywords.text: I love this beautiful beach clear aqua blue water clean sandy bottom very clean lots of beach activities life guards are amazing very accomadating and so helpful (if needed) just about a kilometer out is amazing snorkeling and the fish wow!!!.... so colorful a must visit beach!!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Stunning beach!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: One of the best beaches in the world! Shallow and calm sea with white sand beaches and gorgeous blue water.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: BEACH!!!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: What can I say about the beach in Veradero. Absolutely beautiful! It's clean,the sea was like a warm wave pool. Can't wait to go back.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: One of the prettiest beaches. Clear water, not too much waves in february. Just walk by the beach and sunbeds or umbrellas are available for about 2 CUC each either for rent from some of the hotels or other private companies. Some of the guys who offer sunbeds will also offer the possibility to buy drinks and food, I think they bring it from the hotels. It's possible to use the toilets at some of the hotels.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Clean white sand and crystal clear water
reviewsWithKeywords.text: You cannot compare Varadero Beach to anywhere else.  Clean, clear water, gentle surf and a relaxed atmosphere.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Wonderful beach; white sand, turquiose water.
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Great beach for walking and swimming. Ocean bottom pure sand with no rocks or creepy stuff.   Be sure to always use bug spray before you go on the beach to avoid sand flea bites.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful Beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Cuban beaches are always beautiful and must do if you are in the country. A variety of activities are available to make the experience better

reviewsWithKeywords.title: The best beach of the world
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Varadero is the most wonderfull beach in the whole planet, a paradise in the earth, nice weather, nice people and very safety.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Amazing beach, clear calm sea and golden sand with stunning sunsets. Just choose your hotel wisely. Some are great and some of the all inclusive are way below the standard of the others. Check independent reviews and don’t trust the reviews on the usual ‘booking’ or ‘Hotel’ third party websites - you get what you pay for I suppose!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: beautiful beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beautiful beach, soft sand and beautiful clear waters. Take a pedal boat or hobie cat out. We saw some fish in the shallows and also a jellyfish so be careful. One of the most beautiful beaches in the world!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Great beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: One of the best!l except the included photo is not of Varadero beach. White sand, blue water, clean, fish tried to eat my feet. (Small fish though without teeth. They just felt funny) great time.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Spectactular Beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Even though our Resort (Melias Las Americas) didnt meet our expectation the Beach was a game changer, by far the best Beach we have ever visited Calm, Clear and Clean

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Brisas  del  Caribe
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We stayed at Brisas  del Caribe.   We had a wonderful time.   This has been the 15th time that we have stayed there. You are well looked after from your maid to the  bartenders.   The people are the best.  Birmania looked after us the moment that we walked in till the day we left.  It was our anniversary there and  roses and champagne was on our bed along with a lobster dinner.   What a surprise.   The beaches are very clean and are looked after by Jorge  Machin,  he is always walking up and down the beach picking up debris.  Will we go back next year,   Definitely!!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful and clean
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This is a beautiful beach to sit and relax at. Plenty of things todo and lots of seating. Waters are reasonably calm so it’s nice for a swim

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Best beach we have ever seen!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Although our resort sucked (Royalton) the beach was the saving grace! Spent hours a day out here. Waves weren't too rough.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Thanks
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The Iberostar Bella Vista Varadero Hotel is the best on the best. IT has a beautiful beach and view.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Go for the beaches
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The beaches are, as everyone says, the best! I walked for miles and miles. Sand is warm on your toes and gentle waves wash your feet. They could be better groomed as there was a lot a seeweed on them.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Simply beautiful
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Amazing white sand and tropically warm ocean water. Shallow entry and you can walk out for a hundred meters before you would get up to your neck. You can walk for miles and miles. I would scan the beach if travelling with toddlers to ensure there are no Portuguese man of war jellyfish on shore  ( we encountered 3 of them ). The weather and the beach and the sights were so amazingly beautiful and we look forward to seeing it all again. Wear sunscreen or sit under a Cabana. Beach volleyball, dance lessons, catamaran rides and alcohol available but the water and the warmth of it were the star of the show. February is Cuban winter so the heat was around 30 Celsius and the locals find it cold so you can have large sections of the beach to yourself for privacy. Amazingly blue, beautiful water

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful and could walk for miles :)
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The most beautiful beach I've ever been to before and could walk for miles.  The water was warm and clean and clear.  Saw a few jelly fish washed up on the shore but no other ocean critters.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Absolutely Beautiful
reviewsWithKeywords.text: One of the best beaches we have been too.  Clear green blue water.  White sandy beaches.  Just in awe of it.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Amazing beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beautiful beach area, great for morning walk. I will definitely recommend varadero beach one of them most beautiful beach I have ever seen

reviewsWithKeywords.title: A fantastic beach, White sand Blue water Coconut trees. Heaven.
reviewsWithKeywords.text: A really nice beach well worth the effort to get there. White sand with Blue Sea (The Atlantic).  One of the nicest beaches we have ever visited.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Breathtaking
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Best beach ever!  White sand, turquoise waters, perfect swimming conditions.This is a great spot for beach lovers, sun worshippers and ocean swimmers.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful sand
reviewsWithKeywords.text: I believe this beach is over 7 miles long and I can only claim to have walked about 2 miles of it. But the bit I splodged along in the water was pure fine sand with few shells to be collected on the way. Absolutely beautiful - our sunbeds were those of the Royalton which were fine, plentiful and part of our all inclusive holiday

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Great Beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Stunning beach - have been to this beach before - white sand beach - can walk for 10 Km - crystal clear blue waters

reviewsWithKeywords.title: We love the beach!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Lovely soft sand, floating in the clear warm water, enjoying the hot sun, resting under the palapa, a cool drink, a tasty barbecue; these were the highlights of every beautiful day on the beach. Along with the friendly staff this is why we go to Brisas every year.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Veradero Beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Love this beach. It’s very safe. You’re not harassed by vendors and my belongings were safe. It’s not as nice as cayo coco or Santa Maria but if you don’t want to be secluded, this beach will not disappoint.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Animation/entertainment group was amazing
reviewsWithKeywords.text: I love this place! There was one man working name Johan, Felix chocolate el Jabo el Peque he was amazing! He made our stay even better. He was so helpful, professional and made everyone feel great! He was the best worker! I would go there again

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Avoid the BelleVue Sunbeach hotel and avoid Varadero
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Varadero Cuba is getting bad, boring and empty, avoid! Hotel staff was arrogant, food and drinks selection scale to minimum.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: beautiful open beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: the beach itself is beautiful.. piece of heavenit vaies between smooth and wavy and both are wonderful

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Varadero Beach is the best in Cuba,
reviewsWithKeywords.text: we have been going back every year in the last 6 years. Clean white sandy beach and its been taking care of all the time.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Best Beaches
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The beaches in Varadero are one of the best in Cuba. We enjoyed the cleanliness of them. Swimming in the ocean is an awesome experience.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Most beautiful beach!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Water is crystal clear and you can see right to your feet even in water up to my shoulders.  Love the wonderful waves and body surfing over them.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Amazing!!!!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Crystal clean waters, perfect temperature, very little algae. Lovethe beach in Varadero!!! Would come back in a heartbeat!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Vacation in the sun
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The water was amazing - warm and clean.  The beach however could have been cleaner. Lots of sea weed. Felt the resort should have cleaned it up. The bar on the beach was a shack and totally disappointed. Little to no bar service on the beach. Exchanging towels was a bit of a hassel, as you had to walk back to the pool area. They should have one on the beach,

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beautiful sand, some weeds in some places, crystal clear water, fun to play in the waves. Feels like it goes on forever.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Fun at Beautiful Beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Love the Beach...Beautiful colored water...super clean...best thing about Hotel is right on Beach....very relaxing

reviewsWithKeywords.title: The sand on the beach is very fine. It just like powder, With sea shells on the beach.  The sea is usually calm.
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Very good experience for toddlers and adults. Another good experience is taking sunset photos on the beach with live soft music in the background.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Varadero Beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Varadero Beach was beautiful  Sandy Beach without rocks, although it is in the Ocean it was warm in January

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Day off the resort
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We actually left the resort 2 days and came into town.It was a nice change. The beach is gorgeous. But make sure you have water because it is very hot

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beautiful white sand soft beach turquoise water small sea shells and no seaweed and no motorized boats

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful Sandy Beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beautiful miles of  Sandy Beach without rocks, although it is in the Atlantic Ocean and not the warmest in December, January or February.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Nice sand
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Miles and miles of gorgeous  fine sand with very little seagrass .clean sand and no trash or plastic anywhere even in the morning walk

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The beach at Muthu Playa Varedaro was gorgeous.  Could be raked a bit more often as sometimes stepped on things that were like burs.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Very nice
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Very nice beach, nice place to be with friends and enjoy the beautiful sea surrounding us. Beautiful colors to be impressed in my mind forever

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful Varadero!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Gorgeous white sand beach for as far as the eye can see! Crystal clean water, fun waves and no vendors, no power craft blazing around. Best beach ever!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Amazing as always
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Had an awesome time at the beach. White sand, clear water and glorious sunshine! The weather was fabulous and the ocean was very calm for a couple days.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Day 10 of dark and stormy
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Great swimming and walkingbeach - no rocks no corals, no prickly marine life . But,  it's our day 10 here a d so far we had 2 nice days (January/ February 2020). It's been really, really windy , cloudy and 2 days of heavy rains-  all day. Maybe winter is not the best time to come here , but it's our first time so I have nothing to compare to.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Flour
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This beach is like walking on flour. You can walk for miles in both directions. You can walk in the sea for 100 metres in clear waters The best.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Two oldies 70/80
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The beach is beautiful, very clean, no garbage,  we always had lounges, Machin made sure we always had them even though the beach was over run by very rude and arrogant people.  The beach is one of the best in the world we think.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: AMAZING
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beaches are beautiful and clean .  Lifeguards attentive and no panhandle Cuba beaches beat out many of Caribbean beaches

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Gorgeous beach in Varadero
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Can walk this beach for a long way! Beautiful sand! Loved the scenery of the rock along the sides… And even on windy days it was beautiful to see the waves hit the rocks! The water was warm enough to swim in during our stay and we would visit this beach again any day! We felt very safe

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Clear and can see fish!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: If you want to swim with fish this a perfect beach. Great water, sand, and weather. I do prefer Playa Ancon in Trinidad though, less crowded and shaded chairs everywhere for $2 CUC

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Best beaches anywhere
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The beaches here are second to none , the white sand the clear water (Aqua) no stones and can walk out in the ripple sand for quite a way.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful Beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Undoubtedly, the most beautiful beach and sea water I’ve ever seen. My tip is to find a luxury, 5 star plus or 5 star resort to stay at. Anything less will mar your experience.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Varadero beach

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Amazing place to get away and relax
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Varadero is very much a tourist destination, the beaches are beautiful and the weather is lovely. There's the Cuban charm where even taking a taxi is an experience, being driven around in a 1958 Pontiac convertible just to go down to the store. Some people are quite nice but honestly a lot of them are pretty grumpy, don't smile much and sometimes they don't even talk to you even at the hotels. The market is awesome with lots of cool trinkets (I suggest the market on 15th street) but it does get annoying when you're trying to look around and the vendors will not stop talking about what kind of deals they can give you. Moving around is easy if you buy the 5 peso bus ticket which takes you around the peninsula, they come around every 10-15 minutes and you can get on/off as many times as you want until 9PM. DO NOT accept rides from the horse carriages, they will scam you on prices and get pretty aggressive trying to get you to hop on. I've been to Varadero twice and I could keep coming back there as much as I could. Highly recommended!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Lovely beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Varadero is a beautiful beach that stretches for kilometers.Shallow waters but can be underwater currents at some parts. Never experienced them personally but watched a man struggle to get back and was rescued. Incredible sunsets ❤️Lifeguard at some placesLots of all inclusive guests around the sun chairs. They tend to get drunk and noisy. I love Varadero beach and it’s one of the prettiest beaches I’ve visited in Cuba or elsewhere

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Vacation
reviewsWithKeywords.text: It is hard to believe this beach is real...so beautiful. It goes on and on and on. The sand is so fine and the Cubans staff work hard to keep it clean for tourists. Not everyone is respectful of course and there could be more re-cycling and trash bins easily accessible for those who are. It is not a great place for long swimming as the undertow and sand banks impede this. There is snorkeling and scuba in some spots but you have to take a tour or a boat to get to the reefs.Some bird watching like pelicans but not a lot.Kayaks and catamaran available for rent. I saw windsailing at some spots too. Waves not big enough for surfing. Paddle boards would be funLifeguards watch constantly and enforce rules if someone goes out too far or tries to go in the water when it's too rough. Warning flags are posted daily. Not many locals on the beach except on the weekends when families picnic and bathe. Hotel security guards stop non-guests from trying to venture into a hotel off the beach.There are some vendors selling drinks and trinkets on the beach but not many.Lots of shells and bits of coral to be found for beachcombers but thankfully very little flotsam.Some local fishermen with casting rods and lead weighted nets. I only saw very small fish when swimming.Did not see any piers or wharves for boats, just the remains of a few old posts from 100 years ago.The water is pristine. Every colour blue. Very few weeds or jelly fish. Just relaxing, peaceful, clean, and warm. What a gem!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: The best beach ever !!!!!!!!!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: The real beach ! Not a resort
reviewsWithKeywords.text: I stayed on Calle 31 which was a perfect location for the beach. The beach is amazing and it’s lovely not to be stuck in a soulless resort. The beach is pristine and the sea is literally sea through !! There are snorkelling trips from the beach but to be honest it’s not really all that good . There is no reef and the fish are fed to make them hover about. I did enjoy the boat ride though .Sun loungers are only 2cuc for the day. There are no beach bars or places to eat really so do bring a few bits with you. Though if like me you are in the “real Cuba“ you will know that that means bread and water !  I loved Varadero beach and enjoyed five days of relaxation at the end of my trip. It really is lovely .

The sand is well maintained (at least in front of our hotel) and the water is clean. Dotted along the beach are the hotels' beach volleyball nets and it's fun to watch the players in action. In some areas of the beach (in front of certain hotels) music is played over loudspeakers but more as background music. The locals enjoy this stretch of beach too but they keep their distance from the resort hotels.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: If you want a nice beach and water, go to Varadero
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Varadero has the nicest beach and water of any destination that we've tried, across 3 trips in the last 18 months or so (4 weeks total, summer months).  There are a few shells in the sand here and there, unlike our recent trip to Mexico, but the sand is buttery and luxurious and the water is absolutely the best.  Calm waves and crystal clear water, you can see the sand that you kick up as you move around.  A red flag day might get you a bit of a wave, but compared to e.g., Punta Cana and Cancun, it would be a green flag minus minus in those places.You will see small schools of fish darting around, and when my daughter dropped some small pieces of bread she got a fair bit of marine life attention, much to her delight.I've been to nicer resorts than I've experienced in Varadero, but whenever I visit somewhere else I always wish that I was there, in the water, floating on my back and getting nicely baked.10/10 would recommend and will be going back.

reviewsWithKeywords.text: Ok so my family and I love beach vacations and have done so all over the world. This time we made it out to Cuba and I have to say the Varadero beach is amazing. The sand is very white, clean (very little seaweed or garbage) and the waves vary from huge (6-10ft) to water like glass or as close as you can get on the ocean! We will return and please remember to bring anything you can to give to the locals. They have access to nothing. Literally.  Such a beautiful country and people can’t wait to go back.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: A lovely family holiday
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We needed to get away for some winter sunshine.  I had always wanted to take my son there.  I was so happy when he said he would come with us.  It was just what the Dr ordered, beautiful white sandy beaches that go on for miles, and crystal clear waters.  We would go for long walks either early in the morning or just before sundown.  We would meet locals wanting to give us shells that they had pulled out of the sea, unfortunately we were not able to accept them .  These were  in exchange for anything we could offer.I had already explained to my family how things were in Cuba, so we had taken only clothes and belongings we were prepared to part with, so when we told the Cuban's we had things to give them we would arrange to meet them just before we left and handed over clothes, shoes and toiletries, to people whose need was greater than ours.I also really wanted my son to experience this and be a happy participant.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Vacation.

I love Cubans because they are smily and friendly people, but of course, don’t trust anyone.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Cuban 5 star experience?
reviewsWithKeywords.text: I think I am being more than fair at 3 stars .The setting and welcome was great until our original butler was replaced in about half an hour.Yes you get a butler here, sounds good! Hmmm! Our butler seemed  more like a government spy popping up from behind trees in cupboards, everywhere ,ok ,yes if you leave us alone!or maybe you could do something like a butler would ,pour my bath polish my shoes maybe ,couldn’t even take our cases to our room.If you can’t do it don’t offer it.    Rooms and settings where great ,road nearby I could watch various 1950’s car passing pretty much constant my kind of heaven.    Food was a bit hit and miss cooked ok,a bit disconcerting when a Cuban sparrow is perch on the salad bowl every day ,they do run out of bread and bits and bobs as expected in a country Where there are trade embargoes, but this is Cuba ,you do get that feeling that this is what Jeremy Corbyn would love for the Uk 🇬🇧.The beach is and ocean is probably the best I have bathed in anywhere.5 star beach.   Night time bar was ok but humidity was a big problem for me uncomfortable. Cuba is a must place to visit while it’s in a place of stasis though 5 stars for this although the locals won’t agree ,visit Havana for 3 days first, then an hotel like this but better.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful, clean, non-commercial beaches for miles
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Varadero beaches, for the most part, have a gradual incline into the water, and it slowly gets deep as you wade in. It's quite warm and the is very little current or undertow (relative to say..Acapulco, or Cancun) The sand is soft and safe for bare feet.That being said, if you like to go for long walks, bring swim shoes. As you reach the rocky sections at the peak of each bay, you will find sharp rocks and sea urchins in the shallows. Both can hurt your feet.Also, if you like long walks, bring a drybag with sunscreen, water, footware, hat/swimshirt and some $ CUC, and a snack. The water and sunscreen are probably the most important. A drybag will let you wade in an keep your phone or whatever dry. Cash will let you take a taxi or public bus back if you need.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: So Glad We Went!!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: My husband and I had not planned to go to Varadero, because we were under the impression that it was too far away from Havana, too expensive a taxi ride and maybe not worth it. Luckily we were convinced by everybody that we were mistaken. They were right!!! A taxi hired by our casa, one of the official yellow cabs with great air conditioning was comfortable and safe. I think we paid to have him all day and maybe paid $200. Probably less. When we saw the beach, we were speechless. It was gorgeous. We had faith in the driver who said we could leave all our valuables with him, so all we took were our towels, leant to us from our Casa. We spent about 2 hours frolicking in the crystal clear calm water. There were only like 5 people on the beach, all Cubans, since this beach was a public park. When we went back to the street, our driver was waiting under a tree in a small cafe. Since we hadn't taken our telephones with us, we had not taken any photos. Because of this, my husband ran back and captured beautiful views of the beach for posterity. We highly recommend going to Varadero by taxi. Once in a lifetime-

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful Beach but Not Enough Beds & Construction Work Being Done
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Spent time on Varadero beach whilst staying at Sol Palmeras.  It’s a beautiful beach with clear waters. As part of the all inclusive at the hotel there’s a snack bar serving burgers, chips, Bbq shrimps & paella, although the paella is mainly veggie. The bar also has cocktails, water, juices etc. The staff are very friendly & helpful. Currently on the beach is a huge digger/tractor with a large black pipe going into the water. I believe they are bringing more sand onto the beach although not entirely sure. This is an eyesore on the beautiful beach. I don’t know logistics of this but would have thought it better to do this work during low season perhaps September/October?? We’ve been here for 1 week & tried many times to get sun beds without success, I think people book them very early in the morning I heard as early as 6am. There are not really enough beds to cater for the amount of tourists. However the beach is beautiful & pedal boats, canoes are included as part of the all inclusive. Only reason I’m giving it 3 stars is because of the digger/work being done on the beach right now.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Great beach town with a slight Key West feel to it
reviewsWithKeywords.text: My wife and I stayed in a very comfortable apartment here for two days.  We arrived from Havana by charter/tour bus and were dropped off about 10 blocks (don't worry they're short blocks) from our apartment. After walking the 10 blocks, unpacking and changing clothes, we headed directly for the beach, about 2 blocks away.  Wow! What a beautiful white sugar sand beach.  The waters are beautiful and refreshing. It's been a really long time since I spent so much time actually in the water at a beach.  On Tuesday (our first day here)  there was hardly anyone on the beach, but on Wednesday, which was a Cuban holiday equivalent to Labor Day in the U.S., there was a much larger crowd but still not overly saturated. Drinking is allowed on the beach but life guards are virtually non existant.  While trash cans are plentiful street side at the beach and the many bars, cafes, and restaurants, there are almost none actually on the beach.  People just drop their trash (mostly beer cans) and go.  After a relaxing afternoon, dinner and a walk around town a friendly local directed to the party spot, Calle 62.  We had passed this bar earlier and noticed the side street (62nd Street/Calle 62) was blocked off and was being set up for a steet party and food fair of some sort.  Upon our return we were able to quickly fill the seats of a couple that were leaving the packed establishment.  The very good singers who got the audience on stage and involved  and also a couple of very good cabaret shows.  The side of the bulding has roll up doors, so the view from the curb and street was unobstructed except for a couple of colmns. reviewsWithKeywords.text: We have just returned from a 2 week stay at this resort and I have no words that can describe the actual beauty of this beach!It is white powder sand with crystal clear waters which are warm and there are no rocks or anything on the bottom, just pure white sand. We didn't even see any fish in it!It starts off really shallow and then gradually gets deeper. In an afternoon, there are small deep pools as you get out and they are really hot! The beach stretches for miles and there are lots of people walking along. There are canoes, catamarans and pedalos supplied by the hotel and various fishing trips you can do. If you were to imagine your perfect beach, this would be it!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Brisas del Caribe beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The beaches in Cuba are the most amazing beaches I have ever experienced. At my resort they now have garbage cans posted all along the beach and the beaches are the most beautiful white sand beaches. I float for hours in the warm relaxing waters off of my resort. Someone is willing to help you with chairs at anytime. There are paddle boats and kayaks and sailboat rides always available for guests to enjoy not go mention dancing lessons and volleyball and aqua fitness. Love love love beaches in varadero.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful Beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We went to Varadero on a day trip, just to break the week up, we walked down a side street off the main drag and found a path to the beach. Beautiful spot, the beach was sooooo much better then the beach of the resort. There was hardly anyone there and it was so clean. No garbage no worries. We had no baiting suits so we swam in our shorts or underwear. Ended up staying a few hours. Totally didn’t plan on leaving the resort to goto the beach but it was a great day. I wish there were bars and restaurants a little closer to the beach.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Cuba's Spectacular Jewel
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The long stretch of beach in Varadero is perhaps one of the most beautiful beaches in the world!  Water is crystal clear, the beach is white sand and seemingly endless, and of course, the Cuban culture adds to the charm of this most amazing place.  When visiting, please respect the beauty of this pristine beach.  Don't spoil it with littered cigarette butts and discarded plastic cups in the sand......there are plenty of garbage cans to keep the beach clean.  Remember that you are a guest, in a country that has its own issues to deal with......please don't add to their difficulties.  Embrace the waves,  absorb the culture, dream in the most amazing sunsets, and be respectful of the beauty that warmly welcomed you.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Clean and Peaceful
reviewsWithKeywords.text: I love to just walk these beaches. They all link and there always so pretty and clean! The water is always so blue and the sand is like dust! But  then it gets more changes again. Its gorgeous!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: White sand, palms warm weather

Ideal for laying in the water for hours! But watch out the sun! Protect your skin with a high protection sunscreen!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Fabulous Beach

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Great shoreline
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Soft white sand walking east from Xanadu all along the shore, a brief climb at the stairs and along a rocky outcrop, then back to beach sand at Sol Palmeras resort. More Rocky outcrops after this and forced off the beach by security next resort. Further along sand starts again and continues past Las Antillas up to Royalton. At this point more coarse sand begins with some sharp shells mixed in. We took beach shoes for the rough bits. At times there's a strong  undertow all along Varadero beach. If the wind is up the waves will knock you flat. Flag system is a good warning and clearly posted.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Paradise!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: A long stretch of white sand beach with clear blue water and no crowds. It is paradise! I pray this beach remains untouched and not turned into some very touristy destination where hotels would front it. I like how it is now where you can just go and enjoy a piece of paradise without having to be checked-in to a resort. I heard there is a beachfront hotel there but I didn't see it from where we were. People seemed scattered enough which was nice. This public beach features huts where you can find shade under as well as lounge chairs you can rent for a minimal fee from this local dude I like to remember as Marcelo. It could be his real name but I forget. It was safe for us to leave our belongings while we would go in the water for a swim because he would assure us he's guarding them. He was really nice and entertaining which made our stay here in Varadero beach even more memorable. He makes a good pina colada so make sure you help the guy out as he tries to make an honest living. I would steer clear from the food though. He orders it at a restaurant nearby so can't blame him but the fried pork was tough and tasteless as rubber.Public restrooms are available across the street from the beach but I didn't get to use it as they close at 5PM. Good thing I was dry enough for the 3-hour car ride back to Havana. However, if I really had to, there was a small hotel nearby which had a bar and restaurant with wifi available.The pre-paid cards can be bought from a small shed across from it for 1 CUC. Back to the beach, if I ever go back to Cuba, it will be because of this gem. This was without a doubt my favorite part of this trip.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: A picture turned Reality
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Varadero Beach in Cuba is truly the most picturesque beach I have seen in the world thus far. It truly is a picture turned to reality. The days I went, March 26-30 were not the best for swimming, except the 26th, the day I arrived. The winds were far too strong and the waves were too high, all said though, we were drawn to watching the beautiful torquoise waters and walking alongside the waters. The red flags were a warning not to enter. The day I left, the 30th, the waters were calm enough to swim in. Enough said, it is truly a beautiful sight to endure. The 18th hole on the golf course close by overlooks the ocean- a golfers paradise. I intend to visit when the Cuban winter has ended, hence the stormy waters and enjoy being in Varadero Beach once more.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: WILL DEFINITELY GO BACK
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Outstanding beach!!!! Love Cuba and cannot wait to return.  In regards to the food we did fine. Lots of choices at the all inclusive resorts. Anywhere one travels the food is going to be different... it's all part of travelling.  People need to respect the fact that Cuba does struggle with the availability of food. The resorts do well and frankly I felt badly eating two eggs with breakfast only to learn the Cuban people are only offered 5 eggs a month for a family.  Ergo: Understand that we have access to so much and have become somewhat spoiled.  Definitely take extras with you...pack toothpaste, toothbrushes and other toiletries. The people really need it. Quite expensive for them. The Cuban  people are amazing.  Go with an open mind and realize that everything will not be like home. Hot water at our resort seemed to be available for showers when the kitchens were not washing dishes. Not  big deal. Work around it! I was concerned for the horse carts that take tourists for  rides... I  found out the horses only work two days a week while most people work 6! Haggling is ok... make sure your rides are priced correctly (Per person or for everyone)! Definitely tip... one or two pesos (Convertible currency). Take Canadian $$$ as American money is charged a 10% tax right off the top.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: What A Fantastic Day!!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We were picked up from our hotel as promised in a fantastic 1959 Chevrolet Impala by our driver Armando and our guide, Reniel.Reniel began telling us about his fantastic country immediately and never stopped all the way to Havana.  His knowledge of the history and customs of Cuba is amazing.  We were then dropped off in Havana and Reniel continued to show us the city and tell us all about it.After lunch in a great little private restaurant we then transferred to a 1954 Chevrolet Belair convertible and had an hour around Havana in that with Reniel continuing to tell us tirelessly about the city.Back to Armando in the Impala and then the return journey to our hotel in Varadero.  A fantastic, good value for money for tour, memories we will keep forever.  During the day Reniel took over 100 photos on the SD card that we had provided,  his photographic skills are as good as his knowledge!If you go to Cuba and want to see more and learn more about the country then "I LOVE CUBA TOURS" is a must.  Much better and more personal than a bus tour with another 40 or 50 people!A big thank you To Yosel who organised the tour, Reniel our brilliant guide and last but not least, Armando and his '59 Chevy!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Amazing guided tour
reviewsWithKeywords.text: My wife and I went to Cuba at the end of february and stayed in Habana for 5 days. We really wanted to see the area around the city without having to stay a night and really wanted to go to a beach. We found a guide via a company called "driving through Cuban history" who took us to Varadero beach and showed us a really good spot right on the sea front. Unbeknownst to me we were also going to have cocktails made by our guide! Such an amazing place with incredibly clear water!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Sand and Sea
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This is a beautiful, wide beach with shallow, clear and warm water and clean, soft sand. There are not a lot of amenities here. Some small stores and snack shops are across the street. We paid a small fee to use the bathroom at one of the snack shops there. There was a pushcart on the road selling small but quite good pork sandwiches for $2.00 CUP. I suggest paying in exact change because they tried to give change in the national currency instead of CUP, which is worth only 1/7 of the value of CUP. They argued with me about that, and I borrowed exact change from a friend rather than let them rip me off. These were the only dishonest Cubans I met on my trip. The beach was sparsely occupied, and there was plenty of space to relax in the sand.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Relaxing Carribbean experience
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Have spent lovely 10 days at The Level ( 28 Feb. - 9 Mar. 2019 ) of the hotel Melia Varadero. From the reception at arrival and throughout our stay, we were always greeted with smiles and warmth. The room, the services, food and entertainment, are all at very high level, offering what's needed for a relaxing holiday.I would like to make a special mention however, and commend, the person looking after the special section of the beach for The Level guests of the hotel - Sr. HUMBERTO REYES! A truly lovely man, very committed and devoted to his work, always there to assist in whatever required, greets everybody with a broad smile and very often a hug for those who would be there for a few days already.Sunbeds are cleaned of any remaining sand and made readily available for everybody.His daily feeding of seagulls is truly an attraction, ensuring he is on every mobile phone of the guests coming from all corners of the world.He comes across as hard working with a very open, welcoming and pleasant personality. His heart is truly on that beach. 'El Rey de la Playa' hereby deserves special commendation.Thank you for being such a good host on behalf of Melia Varadero to us, Humberto Reyes.Nikola Mihajlovicfrom Serbia

reviewsWithKeywords.title: It really is one of the most beautiful beaches in the world
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Nothing bad to say about Varadero beach.. long white sandy beach... and the grains of sand are even perfect -- not so small that they stick to everything but not too big that they feel like grit.The resorts are mostly not high rises so the beach is not overpowered by huge imposing resorts. Snorkling is not the best but you can take a catameran and they have a small reef where they will throw bread and you can see many fish there.There are vendors on the beach but they are not aggressive.At night you can watch the sunset... really what more can you ask!

reviews.title: One of the best resorts FOR ADULTS ONLY
reviews.text: The Royalton may be a bit "weathered", after all, it used to be the "Sandals" however a lot of the personnel of that era are still there.However, the food selection as well as the quality of services provided, and the peronnel who go out of their way to solve the few issues you could have while a guest there, make it one of the best (if not the best) on the Island.. This year will be our 13th visit, for 2 weeks as usual. Apart from the pandemic, where almost no one travelled there from Canada, guest rarely have any type of food shortage. Best travel time is mid April to mid October. After that, you hit the bad weather season (Hurricanes) although Varadero has only been hit once, since we travel there, and besides an enormous amount of rain and a few straw coverings of the main lobby bar's roof, nothing elese was damaged. Note that this hotel was one of the very few who has highly powerful and efficient Generators that can supply all the AC each group of rooms,(400) dstributed in the various building. Tip..condiments like Ketchup, French Mustard (high quality) and Tabasco Sauce are not always available. BYO  Bring Your Own.  Noteworthy to mention that this is an Adult only resort, no children. You must be 18 (used to be 21).Make sure that if you like to enjoy the free alcohol that you do not become raudy or agressive. If you do, you will get a warning from security. If you fight, on the premises, amoung yourselves of with another guest, or damage hotel property, YOU WILL BE KICKED OUT and BANNED FROM FURTHER TRAVEL TO CUBA. They do not joke in Cuba about those things, and, don't forget, it is the Millitary that enforce the rules if there is bad behaviour. They will kick you out and forget about refunds. You also may spend the remaining of your holiday in a Cuban cell (Jail or Prison) depending on the offense. Safe and enjoyable travel to all. We leave today !! :-)

reviews.text: Lets begin by remembering Cuba is still under embargo, and suffers mightily for it, so a trip here is for folks already familiar w and as flexible as a 'backpacker'.  Still worth 'the hassle'?  Absolutely.  An amazing getaway.  Arguably one of the best, if not the best, North Amercian beach.  Including many islands and places further S.  Beach itself is not much for shells, but amazing for walking.  And swimming?  The water is clearest ocean outside of SE Asia - Indian Ocean.  Healthy.  and w great coral once you get a bit further out (and bit further under).  Water is so much clearer and cleaner than FL - Gulf Coast.  I.E.  when departing - flying to S Florida take a look out the plane.  The brown water ring around FL starts about 10 - 12 miles out.  Depart FL & fly into Havana.  Look at water on approach.  Yeah.  Blue.  And Varadero is 60 - 90 minutes further E.  An absolute pleasure.  Worth the visit.  (Havana is its own great trip for the intrepid.  Amazing food, art, music).

A country entirely designed for tourists, an empty plastic container, with a kilometre-long beach (beautiful and with a crystal clear sea and with lots of free beach space outside the resorts, cheap umbrellas and deckchairs nothing to say) but nothing more. Empty shops and restaurants without a minimum of authenticity. The only positive note is that it is possible to visit this tourist destination using the casas particulares in the first part of the peninsula, avoid the resorts that I have only heard bad things about (some told us they lacked hot water and even toilet paper). The only other activity that we found valid is free scuba diving which allows you to dive safely. For the rest Varadero is not Cuba! ok two days of rest after a long trip to the real Cuba

We understand that Cuba is under hardship and experiencing shortages, but the trip prices should reflect the services that are being offered. The resort is so nicely kept, the beds are comfortable, the beach is so beautiful, and the pool was pristine. Bar staff were INCREDIBLE and did their best to find a drink you would like. There was no shortage of draft beer, no canned beer, no sodas. There was a lack of nighttime entertainment, but the staff kept things fun during the day. We will return to Cuba, but we are going to explore other resorts. We were disappointed that we weren't recognized as repeat guests. :(

reviews.title: Dirty beach front at Meliá Peninsula Veradero hotel.
reviews.text: The beach is over rated!  Yes, the water is pretty blues, but the shore is sharp w broken shells and tiny rocks. Once you get past that, it’s sandy. This time of year, the beach is infested with Portuguese man O’ war. I was stung, so there’s that. The water was also chilly and quite high waves. It was yellow or red flags most days. When it was green flag, the waters were beautifully calm, but I still saw jelly sacs floating around, so I got out of there!  I guess depending on where you stay, the beach may or may not be clean. The sargassum is very smelly. Also, many tourists are quite dirty, leaving their cigarette butts, plastic cups and other trash dumped around.  I stayed at the Meliá Peninsula Veradero AI resort. It wasn’t a great experience. Maybe other resorts clean the beach front, but this one does not. I’ll be glad to get home tomorrow.

reviews.title: Surveillance is omnipresent in Cuba, beware of rip-offs

After I "outed" myself with a good Cubano, he quickly disappeared into the kitchen in shame.

At the buffet, Melissa, Reinier, Rigoberto and Arelys were always keeping busy and we had what we needed.  Duniel at the beach bar always greeted us with a smile and small talk.  And the team in the lobby always worked well with each other helping each other and taking time to talk with the customers.  Leidy, Mabel, Darlay, Yohamel, Louis, Niurkis, Beatriz and Michel were always attentive and had a warm greeting each time we saw them.
