reviews.title: Impressions from the trip As they say, “above the roof.”
reviews.text: We rested with my wife from August 28 to September 12, 2023 (14 nights). Hotel Muti Playa Varadero. The hotel was only 30-40% full. But this had its plus. There are many free sun loungers on the beach - choose where you like it most. You don’t have to talk about the ocean and the beach, there are only positive and delightful emotions there. That’s why we came here. And the rest of the little things about the tired hotel and the not very rich food in the general restaurant were simply not focused on. On the hotel beach, through local workers, you can agree on the bill excursions to Havana in a vintage car and with a Russian-speaking guide. It cost us 150 bucks for four of us. On the beach you can also buy Coffee (1 kg - $20), cigars 1 box (25 pcs.) - $60 and much more through local hotel workers. The hotel has a varied entertainment program, especially in the evening. You can sign up for the ala carte restaurant almost every other day. Everything is on the menu, but the food is tastier than in the general restaurant. And the service is higher level. In the hotel shops, everything is exorbitantly expensive, it’s better to buy everything in Varadero. There are many markets where locals sell, you can buy souvenirs, rum, etc. You can safely bargain or even exchange for chocolate and various delicacies brought from Russia. At the hotel, we left tips for the maid for cleaning the room with tights, sweets, pills. We never gave dollars to anyone. And this was not required. Everyone was already happy with the gifts. At meals there was always a lot of local fruit - watermelon, pineapple, papaya, bananas , but mangoes are especially delicious in Cuba. Lots of different freshly squeezed juices. At breakfast I drank 3 glasses of mango juice. There are very few Russians in the hotel, 10%/The rest of the contingent are Cubans from the USA. But they don’t interfere with relaxation at all. Only in the general restaurant there are queues for the grill. But to be honest, Cubans don’t know how to fry meat or fish at all. I don’t recommend relying on duty-free; everything at the airport is more expensive than in Varadero. It’s more profitable to buy something in Havana. Prices are 20% lower than in Varadero.

reviews.title: Paradisus Rio De Oro Resort & Spa Pros and Cons
reviews.text: I visited Paradisus Rio De Oro Resort & Spa hotel with the group of friends from August 22-29, 2023.This was my 1-st visit and the last one.    It is nice property but the beach in common section is pretty small and the part of it is rocky. During my stay there were not many visitors (I never saw such an empty hotel before) so you always could find the place in the shade or under the sun.    The service was pretty good. My room request was granted and I had the room on the 2-nd floor in the building close to the lobby. The stairs in the room have to be marked for safety reasons as at night people could fall.    The main concern here was the food (breakfast) and the entertainment.  Not too many options for the breakfast, even the eggs were not there for 2 days and the cooks had to use the egg powderinstead. The cheeses and cold meats variety were very poor. Even the crusted bread which is usually so good in Cuba was not there.The vegetables selection was almost non-existent: shredded carrots, beets, cucumber, corn (from can) and mushrooms (from can). As for fruits the guests could choose from guava, watermelon, papaya and mango. I've never had such sweet and juicy mango as in Paradises, papaya and watermelon were also good. The banana smoothie which is very delicious in Cuba could not be prepared as bananas were missing. Also Pina Colada and Mojito could not be prepared most of the time because of the ingredients shortages.  Brandy, Gin, Cognac, Ron, Whiskey, Vermouth and beer were always in the bar. Coffee was pretty good too.    Because of the small number of guests the main buffet was working mostly for the breakfast we were given opportunity to visit the restaurants for the dinner and this was very good choice as all the restaurants had good menu with sea food and beef/pork/chicken which were delicious and presented in a nice manner. We visited El Patio, Mediterraneo, Tsuru and Los Helechos. I would recommend to visit all of them if possible. We dined at the main buffet twice and the variety was good and plentiful. The ice-cream was very delicious too.   One dinner was set close to the pool and the pool show followed. The dinner was delicious and the show beautiful and very professional. In 1 week we saw 3 shows only and in the evening guests were pretty bored.Overall this was not bad experience but the price/quality ratio was not the best here. It is for sure not 5 *hotel even by Cuban ranking. I paid around $1380 for the single and for CAD $200-$300 cheaper could have the same experience in other 4-4.5 * Cuba hotels.

reviews.title: What you need to know about Cuba before departure
reviews.text: The 13-hour flight was endured quite calmly; to switch to the current time zone, I had Melaxen with me, an ideal solution in such cases. We arrived calmly, the plane was huge, there were a lot of people, we were fed twice. Directly at Varadero airport everything was very fast, then we waited a long time until everyone got ready for the transfer, about 1.5 hours, but many took a taxi.And here I am at the base, with plans to go to bed after dinner and go to the sea in the morning. On the way I meet 2 Russian ladies who say that we should go to the sea right now. And I went. It was about 8 o'clock on the clock, I immediately died from the sunset, it was incredibly beautiful. And then she ran into the water shouting hurray. I’ll look at you when you don’t go anywhere further than Crimea for 7 years 😁 And, it would seem, what could be wrong. But I'm Masha. This means that on the way back from the beach, sand or a shell, or whatever, will hit my slap, but it will tear my leg to pieces right on the foot at the junction of the middle toe. As a result, the next 2 days will be spent in hysterics and searching for antibiotics and antibiotic ointments, because the post-Covid tourist named after me will take everything with him except this. Hysteria, snot tears, non-healing leg. I find chats in the cart of vacationers in Varadero, some guy gives me an antibacterial spray, some man is carrying an antibiotic, a remedy for fungus (because I didn’t understand what it was at first) and a patch for wet calluses from Russia. I offer money for all this, but they don’t take it, even paying for taxi delivery😅 I call the insurance company, no, I didn’t mistype it, because it’s not health insurance, it’s fucked up. Get treatment there at your own expense, and then apply for compensation in Russia. What is the bill, how much is it? There are pharmacies here that don't have anything. There are no medicines on sale here at all; the country is very poor.The security guard at the reception talks about the doctor at the hotel. I'm crying because I'm a girl and I'm scared. Somehow I fall asleep. In the morning I go to her and oh, miracle, she has everything I need. She treats the wound. By the evening, in combination with the guy’s spray, my leg begins to go away, I fall asleep normally for the first time in almost 4 days.Summary:•Bring really ALL medications with you•Make insurance separately from the tour and check the conditions•Find hotel chats and fellow travelers’ chats in advance for really cool excursions at reasonable prices, not like those from a tour operator* Take a hotel with medical staff*And Wi-Fi is not available everywhere. In Melia las antillas there is, in Barcelo solymar it is bad, although it is 5*, and in some 4* there was no Internet either.What else can I say: It's awesome here. Unless you are Masha. If Masha is also awesome, upgrade the option: what to do if 3.14zdets happened)

reviews.title: Stunning beaches with gentle waves
reviews.text: So having done a few oven beach trips with my little one this was the first time he played in the ocean and likely due to the clear water and he could see his feet and the calm waves. The sand was soft and no seaweed or sharp shells or rocks in our resort area. Beaches alone are worth the trip!

reviews.title: WHATEVER YOU DO IN CUBA........GO TO THIS BEACH!!!!!

reviews.title: Very Nice Area
reviews.text: This is a beautiful area about 2 hours from Havana. There are places to stay here - we just went for the day. The water is beautiful. The drive from Havana is cool too; you pass through some very scenic countryside  and towns. We brought o picnic but there seemed to be plenty of places to get food and drinks a quick walk from the beach.

reviews.title: The best swimming beach!
reviews.text: Spring 2023, with all the talk about the sea of seaweed, just want to let you know we saw very , very few on Varadero beach; and even that tiny amount got cleaned up every morning. it is THE best swimming and walking beach!

reviews.title: Beautiful !!!

reviews.title: * If you stay in “Varadero Beach” = 7.0/10 … V. Recommended to stay in “Santa Marta” = 7.6/10
reviews.text: - Tongue with length about 6 km inside the (Atlantic Ocean), long semi wide tree aligned smooth light brown sand Beach with mostly continuous weak Waves with semi strong draw often to E.S. direction depending on the speed of Wind that was often a semi high speed.- Mostly Sunny, you can stay under many Trees to protect in need or the (Rental) of 2 long Seats with Umbrella is not expensive =200 P … But, there is no (Public Services) along the Beach like: Showers, Baths, Changing Rooms, and Vending Portable Water.- There are different types of Transportation along the Beach include: D.D. open-sided hop-on hop-off (Tour Bus) against 5 USD /day fee but it’s look like not important ride along the Roads parallel to the beach shore that are fitted with Cafes, Restaurants, and Craft Shops Plus white*blue “TransTur” Bus against not cheap ticket = 200 P besides recommended more frequent white*red “TransMetro” Local Bus with v. cheap ticket = 10 P only and both of them not frequent 24hr. run along the beach roads until the different other Southern Districts … And, the only “Viazul” Intercity Bus Station for the foreigners at Street 36 on the other eastern road and front of it stand (Shared Taxi) with acceptable fares to travel to different cities … And also, Communication Centre at Street 30 on western beach fitted with a signal to receive the only Wi-Fi “ETECSA” company by using a cheap card = 25 P/1hr. * My (Opinion) is: nothing to do in “Varadero Beach” area it’s only for Relaxation it’s look like not attractive with v. little of shops to buy food & beverage there only some of official “Pan Americans” markets contain limited products in USD price and paid by cards only … So, I am recommended to stay in another closed district like “Santa Marta” that is far in 1 straight line about 2 km S. only to see the People and their Life plus you will find street sellers for vegetables & fruits OR, from small open kiosks /shops that are selling also v. little no. of products with a higher price in CUP OR, you can eat from some cheaper restaurants /shops … (Choose).

reviews.title: Downtime at beach
reviews.text: Stayed at Melia Las Americas for 5 nights are busy time exploring Havana. Lovely relaxed beach resort. Hotel room a bit dated but very clean and staff were very friendly.. Beach was very clean and amazing clear waters. Only downside was sunbeds having ‘reserved’ towels on them very early but people not actually using them until much later. I know you get this everywhere in Europe just wasn’t expecting it here! There were some water sports available at beach and husband went in the snorkelling trip. Said it was great, saw lots of fish.Took bus to Marina and old town one day. Wouldn’t bother with Marina.

reviews.title: Beautiful beach

reviews.title: Varadero Beach bum.
reviews.text: I have to mirror what everyone else has written. Spectacular beach...the water was beautiful and magic to swim in. It was a bath everyday for us, spent hours walking along it and taking in the whole area. It was a brilliant night time wander too, with the moonlight giving just the right amount for taking in the area and feeling like it was ours. Sand was wonderful to walk on, powdery and never boiling hot. Water temperature was fantastic in January and just the right feel too. This was a great place to stay and properly relax and a good place to take excursions from. Dae it!!

reviews.title: One of the best beaches in the Caribbean/Atlantic Ocean
reviews.text: Went in January 2023. Wide long beach, fluffy white sand. Waves are small in the morning and get bigger later on. We had a windy cold spell for two days during which there was a red flag so I'd suggest going in later months. Other than that, the water was cool going in but felt warm during the hotter days - temps average 28 C. Bit of brown seaweed accumulation but was removed the next day. Good beach security at our hotel, Blau Varadero.

reviews.title: Way too many vendors
reviews.text: Varadero beach is still the best beach i've experienced, even though there were a few sea weeds during my last stay. however, I'm not sure if it was the area I was at, or the new reality of cuba since Covid, but the amount of vendors on the beach harassing you day in and day out made it less enjoyable.  There was never a moment where i was able to get in our out of a beach without someone trying to sell me all sorts of legitimate and illegitimate items.  These needs to be better controlled

reviews.title: Excellent stayiing in Varadero, Cuba
reviews.text: Always Choose an All Inclusive Hotel in CUBA, because it could be difficult to go by yourself to a restaurant. Sometimes they do not accept your dollars or your credit card, and -I know it is surprising- they do not accept even the Cuban Peso!!! Some places only accept the Cuban credit Card, reserved for locals!!!we stay stayed in Melia, and it was sensational!! DO get the tour: catamaran with Dolphins. Exceptional !! Try to get a flight from your country to VARADERO and NO HAVANA. !! Stay at least 4 nights in Varadero. From Varadero pick one or 2  full days to visit Havana WITH A GUIDE.  CUBA is VERY safe, BUT locals bother you all the time.

reviews.title: Not sure we will go back unless maybe on a Monday.
reviews.text: This place is suppose to be the Jewel Beach area of Cuba…. ReallyMaybe only at the resorts.I rented a house there, one block from the beach, for myself, my wife, and all her family.The town its self was ok, you can tell the economy is hurting there, which is sad. Not a lot of tourist did I see, but lots of people over the weekend. Thank goodness we brought all our own food and Beer. There was not a single beer for sale in all of Varadero, except the one place we found that had beer, you had to order an entree and then you could buy 2. No more.I also have to say the sand and water at the beach were indeed beautiful; however, there were mountains of trash everywhere. Visitors to the beaches actually just throw all their trash on the ground like they have zero manners for others or our planet. But Thank God there came tractors and people on Mondays to pick what they saw all up. What I did not understand was there are actually trash cans and dumpster there and were empty…I think we will look for a less popular beach destination in Cuba for our next visit.

reviews.title: Tropical Paradise.
reviews.text: Fantastic beach. Gorgeous soft sand and crystal clear turquoise waters. The beach slopes gently into  beautiful calm waters. From our hotel the parasols offer some much needed relief from the relentless heat of the sun. Be very careful. The sand will quickly burn your feet.

reviews.title: Great family vacation.

Everyone is professional,  helpful and friendly,  going above and beyond to ensure that the guests have a great experience. The animation team keeps everyone entertained with lots of activities. There is plenty of fun for the little ones, featuring Misladys who provides them with games and fun activities, the children as well as the adults love her. This is a great spot for a family vacation.

reviews.title: Excellent 9 Days at the Sanctuary
reviews.text: We had a wonderful experience at the Sanctuary Grand Memories Resort.  We were warmly welcomed by staff with a drink and ready to help us get to our rooms.   A big shout out to the Team, Hilda, Butlers - Mario, Renee, and Joanne.  They always went out of their way to make sure we had a wonderful time.  Mario helped us plan a trip to Havana and we had an awesome experience.  Mario and Renee made sure we had everything we needed and always were very pleasant and helpful.  The Sanctuary Restaurant - Breakfast and Dinner - excellent meals. Chef Enzo (Vincenzo) always provided us with delicious meals.  The entire wait staff at breakfast and dinner were friendly and terrific!  The manager of the restaurant- is very friendly and accomodating.  Roxanne and the pool bar staff were exceptional!  Awesome service and laughs with Milli and her team at the Cigar bar/lounge.  Fantastic chocolate espresso martinis.  We had a great time, hot, sunny days, beautiful beach and all-round excellent staff!  We are looking forward to visiting everyone again in the near future.

reviews.title: Prettiest beach  in the world
reviews.text: Yes, I know, travel agents rate Varadero beach as #1 in the world some years, number 3 or 4 other years. But really,  it's a three hour flight from Toronto, the residents are welcoming to tourists, esp. Canadians, and the beach is stunningly clean and uncrowded, with calm azure water that's absurdly warm, and a soft sandy bottom, with modest or very modest waves. Beach gals, and guys, hello!

reviews.title: such a beautiful and serene beach.

reviews.text: From Feb 8 until Feb 15, beach time consisted of maybe 2 hours before the storms hit, so if you are convincing yourself that you will be able to turn a blind eye to the harsh demeaning conditions of Cuba by sun and beach worshipping, think again.

reviews.title: Stunning Beach

reviews.title: Beautiful beautiful place! No one here!
reviews.text: Varadeo Beach is one of the most beautiful beaches in the world!  We are staying just outside the town as we speak!  Cuban people are some of the most beautiful people in the world!  They have nothing but would give the shirt off their back if they could!  With covid and the new form of currency it is very difficult to feed themselves and their children.  I hope people will start to feel safe soon and come back!  It is safe here!  95 percent vaccinated, always wearing a mask and starting 5th vax next week!  Consider Cuba!  Bring gifts!

reviews.title: Lovely beach but...

reviews.title: Great beaches

reviews.title: the best beach and sea I have ever visited. Especially in December it is an amazing place
reviews.text: The beach and the sea is outstanding. Never have experienced such a lovely place. The water is sooooo nice, warm . You can walk deep into the sea and it is a quiet place. The beach is never hot, even when the sun is always shining on. The beach is cleaned very properly on a daily base! Spot on!

reviews.title: Beach is very nice. Not too suitable for non smokers
reviews.text: People will smoke right next you. Also, even though signage prohibits this, people will reserve their beach chair by leaving items while they go to lunch. Watch your children! The lifeguards are usually doing blackmarket buisness and not watching.

reviews.title: 10+ Beach! White sand and aquamarine Water!
reviews.text: By far the best beach in Cuba. Stay at a good resort like the Paradiso or Royalton if you want to eat edible food. We stayed for 10 days and I would come back again.

reviews.title: world class

reviews.text: Sand,  mostly clear water, modest waves.Long, many miles to walk.Local salesmen bother just a little.

reviews.title: Turquoise waters await
reviews.text: Beautiful turquoise water and soft sands are along the shores of Varadero Beach.   Hotel beaches are wonderful but the public beaches in town also have a charm of their own. A great place to relax in the calm morning waters or play in the waves in the afternoon.  It is my go-to for warm weather fun.

reviews.title: Super soft, Super white, Super nice!
reviews.text: Varadero beach is the trip advisor number 1 for cuba and its not hard to see why; it really is breath-taking! I do feel though that where you stay and how you experience the beach will influence your opinion - so treat yourself and stay in a luxury hotel with beach front access. we did a range of water sports here and have lovely memories. The water is so soft, clear and your bodily quickly adapts to the temp so its easy to dip in and out of the sea :)

reviews.title: The best beach
reviews.text: Sandy shallow beach, warm water, although I have known this from prior visits. When I want to enjoy the beach during the Canadian winter I go to Varadero

reviews.title: Beautiful beach

reviews.title: Good time to travel

reviews.title: Slice of paradise
reviews.text: You can’t fault this beach!Soft white sand,gently shelving and very suitable for young children.Shells are gorgeous along this strip and we found loads of sand dollars.loved watching the crabs pop up and down into the holes.We had a few red flag days during our stay but jumping the waves was huge fun!

reviews.title: Stunning beach
reviews.text: The beach at Varadero is stunning.  It is postcard perfect with soft white sand, stunning clear warm water that you can walk quite a way out in. Fabulous!

reviews.title: Disconnected from the USA
reviews.text: Varadero beach. Stayed at an Airbnb right on the beach. Couldn’t have been any nicer. Right around 62nd Beatles club 1.5 blocks away with live bands 7x a week Calle 62 for salsa dancing and live shows. They shut down the road to all car traffic. This place is great. Been 3 times - 4th coming up in 3 weeks.

reviews.title: Sol palmeras 2020
reviews.text: It is a clean beach with few people. Quite calm and very pretty. The sand is fine and white, in these months it has a little more waves.

reviews.title: Long beach perfect for walks
reviews.text: So beautiful, you can walk for hours and when we went in November we watched the sunsets every night!

reviews.title: Beach is clean and pretty but little to do
reviews.text: The beach is beautiful, but little to do, the hotel don’t let you take the sailing boats out on your own like they do on other Caribbean bean islands. No bars or clubs on the beach, Just sand and sea and yourselves. Great for hermit crabs and general crabs.. lots of good wildlife.other beaches on the island were a lot better. Bay of pigs highly recommended.

reviews.title: As good as it gets
reviews.text: One word to describe this beach Breathtaking. It is what you envisage when thinking about a Caribbean  Beach, which this one is no exception. Rated here on TripAdvisor in the top 5 beaches in the world and from what we saw well deserved, the sand is soft and the water crystal clear, light blue, warm and super inviting. We were fortunate that the beach is also manned by the resort security which meant that the guests had the whole beach to themselves which made it an even more enjoyable experience. It is just like the postcards and the TV advertising shows. Photos & footage do not do it justice seeing it in real life is the ultimate experience. We spent a lot of the time in the water as it was so warm clean and refreshing as the sun was super hot. The resort provided  plenty of deck chairs that reclined and also large umbrellas to shade you from the sun but the heat still made the water a Great Escape and a real relief to which you found it hard to leave behind.

reviews.title: Boring with no charm!
reviews.text: The sea and beach is beautiful enough, but a bit boring. There is absolutely nowhere to sit down and eat or drink with a sea view if you don’t live on an all inclusive hotel by the sea front. We thought it was ridicolous. We stayed less than 24 hour and moved on to a more beautiful and interesting place!

reviews.title: Ah, the Beautiful Beach!
reviews.text: This is why we came to Cuba. Sit on the beach, take in the sun, and play in the water. We were here in mid-February. The water was warm, the sun was hot, it was great. Oh, one day it was closed for jellyfish, but the lifeguards were letting people know, and keeping us safe. We were on the beach near our hotel, and it was just amazing!  I can't wait to go back next year!

reviews.title: beautiful
reviews.text: the best beaches, the water is cristalline and you can see the pieces, when it's windy its better not to get in, because of the waves.

reviews.title: The best!
reviews.text: Been to Veradero 8 times, the beach is spectacular. Was due to leave tomorrow, obviously not happening now, but hoping for next year. White sand for miles, turquoise water, perfection..

reviews.title: Beautiful blue beach
reviews.text: Thank goodness we found the beach pretty quiet for a populated tourist hub. Water was the bluest I’ve ever seen and the sand was powered white. Shady areas go quick so plan to be in the sun or a cafe/bar. Gorgeous spot one block away and parallel to main road. An easy and interesting walk.

reviews.title: One of the best beaches in the world
reviews.text: This really is one of the nicest tourist beaches in the world. It's consistently nice and sandy along the whole strip, shallow, friendly to swimming, and just looks beautiful.

reviews.title: Most beautiul beach

reviews.title: Beautiful Beach!

reviews.title: The best beach I have ever been to
reviews.text: Beautiful white sand blue sea. Nice sun beds and lovely lifeguards. The snack bar had great cuban sandwiches I can’t wait to go back

reviews.title: Best beach
reviews.text: The best beach with clean and clear water soft white sand and beautiful sunsets. Please bring a reusable cup to cut down on plastic waste.

reviews.title: Beautiful walkable beach
reviews.text: So shallow and turquoise, our hotel held many activities here to enjoy, quite flat and easy to walk.

reviews.title: Miles of white sand beach
reviews.text: The Varadero beach is superb!  Miles of white sand stretch before you leading you into the warm and usually calm Caribbean Sea.

reviews.title: One of the best beach in the Carribean
reviews.text: Cooler and winder some days in the winter months of Jan, Feb, March, this beach is a wonderful paradise year long.  Long walks on white sand!  I am however disappointed in the continuous use of plastic cups and straws from the majority of Cuban hotels.This beach is wonderful to take long swims as well.

reviews.title: Beautiful white sand beaches!
reviews.text: Loved the beach, the sun and the warm weather. Not a fan of Varadero though. I've been to so many other lovely places in Cuba that Varadero just doesn't do it for me anymore. By far the best beach is in Cayo Coco, the best vacation spot for me is Guardalavaca beach in Holguin. Cayo Largo is an isolated island and not a place I would go to again. Cayo Santa Maria is gorgeous but windy. Havana is great for a day visit if you're in Varadero but I personally wouldn't stay overnight. Hotels that are internationally owned in partnership with Cuba have a much better selection of food so keep that in mind.

reviews.title: Sand, sea and sky
reviews.text: There are two parts to Varadero, the old town and the new town where there are many modern beach resorts which make the most of this beautiful location.

reviews.title: Beach of my dream
reviews.text: Beautiful color, white sand, clean water. Long enough for long walks on the shore. Not too deep to go to swim. Quiet, not crowded. Almost perfect!

reviews.title: Beach
reviews.text: Beaches here are SO beautiful! If I could just live on the beach for my entire sty it’s beautiful wether I would have been happy.

reviews.title: Wow!!!
reviews.text: The best beach I’ve seen!!! You can walk for hours!! We sure we will be going back!! You can relax, or play or swim. There are great places to eat near by too.

reviews.title: Great beach warm sea
reviews.text: Was a lovely place to visit. Silky soft sand and the sea was warm and calm. Our hotel was right on the beach so we had waiter service for cold drinks...all amazing

reviews.title: Melia las americas
reviews.text: I’m turning 60 in April and I booked a week for my wife and I to go back to the Melia las Américas , the girls at the front desk and inside the level office made our stay easier , I would recommend this level to anyone . Food beach entertainment rooms , all good ! See u in a month !

reviews.title: One of the most beautiful beaches in the world, bar none
reviews.text: Stayed at the Blau Hotel resort and truly enjoyed the beach in Varadero. Third time in the area and never get tired of the soft sand, wide beach, beautiful water,  all on hand and available. Can’t ask for more

reviews.title: overall an excellent value for your money
reviews.text: In general  one should not be afraid of traveling to Cuba. Just remember the star rating is one below North America. So I will never go below a four star rated hotel. Don"t expect too much with the food because for the price you're only paying for Air,Climate ,Beach and SAFETY. Your trip will be more enjoyable this way.

reviews.title: Nice sunny days
reviews.text: Nice long beach. Sea water was great, and it wasn’t windy. So it was nice to be on beach all day. You have places were to hide from sun and drink some nice cocktails.

reviews.title: Town of veradero
reviews.text: We were able to take the hop on and off bus for 5 cuc per person . It was a very cheap way to travel from the resort to the town . We enjoyed the view . You can hop on and off all day long. If you get a chance stop at the small market we liked shopping there more then the big market . The big market we found the sales people a little pushy. However there is a street vendor selling awsome coconut runs and piña Clauda . If you get a chance stop at the all Capone mansion . It was cool to see and free . The beach outside there was amazing with a guy feeding pelicans . So cool . Just be aware of the horse and buggy ride. We were cautious of this because we heard the stories of people getting screwed but we talked about how much before we got on but when we got off omg the price was different . 80 cuc for the four of us holy cow we were originally told 10 . So be warned

reviews.title: Varadero beach is five star
reviews.text: This is still one of the best beaches in the world.  I have been to many beaches in the Caribbean and this is still around the top of the list even after my second visit.

reviews.title: Fres and clean beach
reviews.text: Very clean with clean water. A wonderful beach with offers of pedal boats, cano rent and small sail boats. Relaxing for singles and families.

reviews.title: Rated as one of top ten beaches in the world.
reviews.text: We stayed nearby At Arenas Doradas which has access to the beach.  The sand is a gorgeous colour.  Many of the pictures of swaying palms, uncrowded, do not reflect the reality.  Each hotel has staked out a section and there is wall to wall beach reclining chairs.   You will be approached by locals selling stuff but they are not aggresive as in Mexico, nor do they come right in among the tourists.  Most hotels have a staff of security down on the beach.This area has rip tides and the caution flags were flown all the week we were there.

reviews.title: Labranda Resorts
reviews.text: Clear Blue Water , White Sandy Beaches! Really enjoyed swimming in the ocean, water was warm and inviting.

reviews.title: Quiet and Wonderful
reviews.text: When we were at this beach, I was amazing at how quiet it was. There were only about 1 dozen people on the beach or in the water, with the odd visit from people who were curious and just came to check it out. There were no services that I could see, except if we were to go off the beach to the streets. The beach was clean and well-kept.

reviews.title: Amazing beach!
reviews.text: I couldn’t fault the beach in any way. It was perfect, with the best sunset at the end of the day. Couldn’t have been any better to be honest.

reviews.title: Best beaches
reviews.text: Can't get enough of these beaches.just beautiful.always clean and well kept.will return every time get the urge for some sun.

reviews.title: Varadero Beah
reviews.text: Varadero beach is fantastic! You can walk for miles on the beautiful white sand. Excellent! Most resorts along the peninsula have this beach.

reviews.title: Most beautiful beach in the world
reviews.text: Every time  I come back I'm never disappointed in this beach. I never get over the turquoise color of the ocean or the beautiful white sand of the beach.

reviews.title: Clean and beautiful
reviews.text: There is a reason this is one of the most beautiful beaches in the world.  It has life guards . It is soft sand and graded for flotsam and jetsom on a daily basis.

reviews.title: 22 kilometers white sandy beach
reviews.text: Whats not to like,about the beach all swimable.Gorgeous blue green water clean and clear.However because the Cubans have not been taught to recycle bottles&cans you see it on the beach.I gather what i can ,lay it in the middle of beach gets picked up by a grater that cleans in the morning.Returning is now in effect and you can be fined but this is quite new.

reviews.title: Diamond Club beach
reviews.text: Terrific. And staff is friendly. Own private area on the beach. Water was a tad chilly but I went for the sun.

reviews.title: Holiday
reviews.text: Beautiful place a must visit for your bucket list!!! The beech is cleaned daily and a tractor rakes it , gorgeous warm sea , we stayed at the Blau hotel so right on the beech ...... amazing place , Cuba needs tourist badly , please visit you will not be disappointed.....

reviews.title: Beautiful beach
reviews.text: My husband and I revisited Cuba after many years. The beach is still as beautiful as ever. As a non swimmer, I felt xo for table going into the water as it is quite shallow and not a lot of undertow. The sand is white and soft. I will definitely go back for the water, sand and sun.

reviews.title: Most amazing beach!
reviews.text: The beach is what keeps us coming back to Cuba each year. That beautiful turquoise color and white sand. Love how clear the water is with no rocks and rarely any seaweed.

reviews.title: Beauty...
reviews.text: Varadero's beach is absolutely beautiful and I don't think you could ever get tired of it.  We saw it at sunrise, sunset, during calm and during stormy times, and it was awesome every time.  Water is crystal clear.  The sand right at the shore is on an angle, so walking along the shore is a bit awkward.  The sand in general is deep, so it's a workout to walk for a long stretch, but still worth every second.

reviews.title: Varadero Beach
reviews.text: Beautiful long beach...can be quite windy, be careful of jellyfish on really windy days. Never crowded.

reviews.title: Varadero Beach
reviews.text: Fourth time there  never lets us down , great beaches.  Prefer staying at south end walking distance  of the stripand Santa Marta .

reviews.title: Beaches are clean
reviews.text: Some of the best beaches down south. Water is warm and beaches usually cleaned every day . So nice to walk and explore

reviews.title: Housekeeper All the staff work very and specially Dayami is  ahappy  professional to do her job and take care  customers
reviews.text: Dayami is a wonderful human being that work hard and make Grand Memories shine. she deserves a promotion.we will come back for that excellent services.thank you,

reviews.title: Beautiful beach
reviews.text: A beautiful beach spoilt by tourists.  San and blue seas but an opportunity for water sports.  There is a beach bar and many sun loungers but ca be noisy with music but this is Cuba

reviews.title: Gorgeous beach and clear water
reviews.text: This has got to be one of the best beaches I've ever walked on. The sand is white and free of debris with very little sea weed or rocks. Perfect for swimming.

reviews.title: Best beach ever
reviews.text: I love this beautiful beach clear aqua blue water clean sandy bottom very clean lots of beach activities life guards are amazing very accomadating and so helpful (if needed) just about a kilometer out is amazing snorkeling and the fish wow!!!.... so colorful a must visit beach!!

reviews.title: Stunning beach!
reviews.text: One of the best beaches in the world! Shallow and calm sea with white sand beaches and gorgeous blue water.

reviews.title: BEACH!!!
reviews.text: What can I say about the beach in Veradero. Absolutely beautiful! It's clean,the sea was like a warm wave pool. Can't wait to go back.

reviews.title: Beautiful beach
reviews.text: One of the prettiest beaches. Clear water, not too much waves in february. Just walk by the beach and sunbeds or umbrellas are available for about 2 CUC each either for rent from some of the hotels or other private companies. Some of the guys who offer sunbeds will also offer the possibility to buy drinks and food, I think they bring it from the hotels. It's possible to use the toilets at some of the hotels.

reviews.title: Clean white sand and crystal clear water
reviews.text: You cannot compare Varadero Beach to anywhere else.  Clean, clear water, gentle surf and a relaxed atmosphere.

reviews.title: Wonderful beach; white sand, turquiose water.
reviews.text: Great beach for walking and swimming. Ocean bottom pure sand with no rocks or creepy stuff.   Be sure to always use bug spray before you go on the beach to avoid sand flea bites.

reviews.title: Beautiful Beach
reviews.text: Cuban beaches are always beautiful and must do if you are in the country. A variety of activities are available to make the experience better

reviews.title: The best beach of the world
reviews.text: Varadero is the most wonderfull beach in the whole planet, a paradise in the earth, nice weather, nice people and very safety.

reviews.title: Beautiful beach
reviews.text: Amazing beach, clear calm sea and golden sand with stunning sunsets. Just choose your hotel wisely. Some are great and some of the all inclusive are way below the standard of the others. Check independent reviews and don’t trust the reviews on the usual ‘booking’ or ‘Hotel’ third party websites - you get what you pay for I suppose!

reviews.title: beautiful beach
reviews.text: Beautiful beach, soft sand and beautiful clear waters. Take a pedal boat or hobie cat out. We saw some fish in the shallows and also a jellyfish so be careful. One of the most beautiful beaches in the world!

reviews.title: Great beach
reviews.text: One of the best!l except the included photo is not of Varadero beach. White sand, blue water, clean, fish tried to eat my feet. (Small fish though without teeth. They just felt funny) great time.

reviews.title: Wonderful
reviews.text: I went to the Iberostar Bella Vista Varadero Hotel and I can tell to everybody that was a wonderful experience.

reviews.title: Good
reviews.text: We went there to celebrate my birthday and was very good. We love the cuban people because they are very lovely.

reviews.title: Spectactular Beach
reviews.text: Even though our Resort (Melias Las Americas) didnt meet our expectation the Beach was a game changer, by far the best Beach we have ever visited Calm, Clear and Clean

reviews.title: Brisas  del  Caribe
reviews.text: We stayed at Brisas  del Caribe.   We had a wonderful time.   This has been the 15th time that we have stayed there. You are well looked after from your maid to the  bartenders.   The people are the best.  Birmania looked after us the moment that we walked in till the day we left.  It was our anniversary there and  roses and champagne was on our bed along with a lobster dinner.   What a surprise.   The beaches are very clean and are looked after by Jorge  Machin,  he is always walking up and down the beach picking up debris.  Will we go back next year,   Definitely!!

reviews.title: Best part
reviews.text: Aside from people spitting on the beach and panhandlers harassing us, nice beach. It was the only nice part of our stay.

reviews.title: Beautiful and clean
reviews.text: This is a beautiful beach to sit and relax at. Plenty of things todo and lots of seating. Waters are reasonably calm so it’s nice for a swim

reviews.title: Beware horse drawn carriage rides in Varadero
reviews.text: Horse drawn carriage in Varadero beware! They will tell you a set price then charge you that price per person each way. They took us to a restaurant about 15 mins by horse and brought us back - 6 of us for about 150$ Canadian - we were told it would be 10$. Nope 10$ each - each way per person. Our fault for not asking a lot of questions assuming they were being honest. Get the price settled before you get in the carriage. Felt swindled. We could have had a driver from our hotel for the day for the same price - transfers - wait for us while we toured etc. Not impressed !!

reviews.title: Best beach we have ever seen!
reviews.text: Although our resort sucked (Royalton) the beach was the saving grace! Spent hours a day out here. Waves weren't too rough.

reviews.title: Thanks
reviews.text: The Iberostar Bella Vista Varadero Hotel is the best on the best. IT has a beautiful beach and view.

reviews.title: Go for the beaches
reviews.text: The beaches are, as everyone says, the best! I walked for miles and miles. Sand is warm on your toes and gentle waves wash your feet. They could be better groomed as there was a lot a seeweed on them.

reviews.title: Simply beautiful
reviews.text: Amazing white sand and tropically warm ocean water. Shallow entry and you can walk out for a hundred meters before you would get up to your neck. You can walk for miles and miles. I would scan the beach if travelling with toddlers to ensure there are no Portuguese man of war jellyfish on shore  ( we encountered 3 of them ). The weather and the beach and the sights were so amazingly beautiful and we look forward to seeing it all again. Wear sunscreen or sit under a Cabana. Beach volleyball, dance lessons, catamaran rides and alcohol available but the water and the warmth of it were the star of the show. February is Cuban winter so the heat was around 30 Celsius and the locals find it cold so you can have large sections of the beach to yourself for privacy. Amazingly blue, beautiful water

reviews.title: Amazing place to get away and relax
reviews.text: Varadero is very much a tourist destination, the beaches are beautiful and the weather is lovely. There's the Cuban charm where even taking a taxi is an experience, being driven around in a 1958 Pontiac convertible just to go down to the store. Some people are quite nice but honestly a lot of them are pretty grumpy, don't smile much and sometimes they don't even talk to you even at the hotels. The market is awesome with lots of cool trinkets (I suggest the market on 15th street) but it does get annoying when you're trying to look around and the vendors will not stop talking about what kind of deals they can give you. Moving around is easy if you buy the 5 peso bus ticket which takes you around the peninsula, they come around every 10-15 minutes and you can get on/off as many times as you want until 9PM. DO NOT accept rides from the horse carriages, they will scam you on prices and get pretty aggressive trying to get you to hop on. I've been to Varadero twice and I could keep coming back there as much as I could. Highly recommended!

reviews.title: Vacation
reviews.text: It is hard to believe this beach is real...so beautiful. It goes on and on and on. The sand is so fine and the Cubans staff work hard to keep it clean for tourists. Not everyone is respectful of course and there could be more re-cycling and trash bins easily accessible for those who are. It is not a great place for long swimming as the undertow and sand banks impede this. There is snorkeling and scuba in some spots but you have to take a tour or a boat to get to the reefs.Some bird watching like pelicans but not a lot.Kayaks and catamaran available for rent. I saw windsailing at some spots too. Waves not big enough for surfing. Paddle boards would be funLifeguards watch constantly and enforce rules if someone goes out too far or tries to go in the water when it's too rough. Warning flags are posted daily. Not many locals on the beach except on the weekends when families picnic and bathe. Hotel security guards stop non-guests from trying to venture into a hotel off the beach.There are some vendors selling drinks and trinkets on the beach but not many.Lots of shells and bits of coral to be found for beachcombers but thankfully very little flotsam.Some local fishermen with casting rods and lead weighted nets. I only saw very small fish when swimming.Did not see any piers or wharves for boats, just the remains of a few old posts from 100 years ago.The water is pristine. Every colour blue. Very few weeds or jelly fish. Just relaxing, peaceful, clean, and warm. What a gem!

There are no beach bars or places to eat really so do bring a few bits with you. Though if like me you are in the “real Cuba“ you will know that that means bread and water !  I loved Varadero beach and enjoyed five days of relaxation at the end of my trip. It really is lovely .

reviews.title: James P
reviews.text: My first tropical vacation was to Cuba in 1991. Since then, I’ve been to over half a dozen Caribbean destinations/countries. Cuba is still a favorite. It is a short 3 hour flight from Toronto, just in time to watch a feature-length movie and you’re there. The taxi from the airport to the resort is usually around 30 minutes or you can take the bus included with your all-inclusive vacation. The bus departs approximately two hours after landing though so, you could miss out and some activities but it’s free so that’s the decision you will have to make. This was the first time I have noticed Portuguese man-of-war’s on the beach. This is a bit of a concern. Global warming? Anyway, be mindful of them and bring a snorkel and mask if you’d like to see the pretty tropical fish. I find certain resorts have natural habitats where the fish like to feed. They aren’t so prevalent in the nice sandy beach areas. Look for places that have rock outcrop‘s, you’re sure to find lots there. If you have trouble spotting them, bring a slice of bread, they’ll come out from everywhere.

reviews.text: The beach was a pleasure to visit, great place to relax.  Water was warm and refreshing.  Rented a small catamaran with captain located on the beach, for 20 pesos.  Sailed for 20 min to a spot not far from shore. 1 hour of snorkellying--- lots of fish guarnteed, anchors, and other sights. Then 20 minutes back to my hotel's beach.  Great chance for some one on one with a local too.  Very friendly and informative.  Well worth it.

reviews.title: It's as beautiful as everyone says
reviews.text: It's a cliche, but the beach really is beautiful. If you're a runner, go barefoot on the edge of the waves - can't beat it!

reviews.title: A Beautiful Beach to Visit
reviews.text: This is a beautiful beach and not overly crowded in spite of its proximity to so many resort hotels. The sand is well maintained (at least in front of our hotel) and the water is clean. Dotted along the beach are the hotels' beach volleyball nets and it's fun to watch the players in action. In some areas of the beach (in front of certain hotels) music is played over loudspeakers but more as background music. The locals enjoy this stretch of beach too but they keep their distance from the resort hotels.

reviews.title: One of the best beaches
reviews.text: Been to varadero beach twice now and it’s one of the best beaches in the world and it must be seen.Plenty of snorkeling to be done it’s just an amazing beach.

reviews.title: If you want a nice beach and water, go to Varadero
reviews.text: Varadero has the nicest beach and water of any destination that we've tried, across 3 trips in the last 18 months or so (4 weeks total, summer months).  There are a few shells in the sand here and there, unlike our recent trip to Mexico, but the sand is buttery and luxurious and the water is absolutely the best.  Calm waves and crystal clear water, you can see the sand that you kick up as you move around.  A red flag day might get you a bit of a wave, but compared to e.g., Punta Cana and Cancun, it would be a green flag minus minus in those places.You will see small schools of fish darting around, and when my daughter dropped some small pieces of bread she got a fair bit of marine life attention, much to her delight.I've been to nicer resorts than I've experienced in Varadero, but whenever I visit somewhere else I always wish that I was there, in the water, floating on my back and getting nicely baked.10/10 would recommend and will be going back.

reviews.title: Tropical Caribean weather
reviews.text: The beach was just amazing white sand, with that emerald green and blue sea colour, Temperature of the water was just right. The sand was very clean and there were plenty of beach chairs and lots of space to accommodate everyone comfortably.

reviews.title: Safety, tranquility, and serenity
reviews.text: beach finally back to its original splendor since the hurricane.  Still some places with a lot of shells so it's a good idea to bring sandals if you want to walk on the beach.  One can walk for miles along Varadero's beach front.  We felt safe, and were never bothered by merchants trying to sell stuff.

reviews.title: This place holds my heart

If you can put up with Soviet era buildings and eat the amazing local food at little restaurants off the main strip, then you may just find the nicest people in the most beautiful place on earth.

reviews.title: One of the last?
reviews.text: Ok so my family and I love beach vacations and have done so all over the world. This time we made it out to Cuba and I have to say the Varadero beach is amazing. The sand is very white, clean (very little seaweed or garbage) and the waves vary from huge (6-10ft) to water like glass or as close as you can get on the ocean! We will return and please remember to bring anything you can to give to the locals. They have access to nothing. Literally.  Such a beautiful country and people can’t wait to go back.

reviews.title: Beautiful
reviews.text: A really great, long beach with powdery white sand, tourquis water and awesome swimming. What more could you ask for in a beach.

reviews.title: Best Beach Ever!!!👍🏽👍🏽🇨🇺
reviews.text: I have been traveling the Caribbean for over 20 years. I’ve been on many beaches. Varadero Beach is #1. No seaweed! Nobody bothering you! No rocks! No shells!  It’s perfect! Also, We ordered the lobster meal for $17 pesos. The water is BEAUTIFUL and crystal clear!!! 🏖🇨🇺Oh. And Cuba is easy to get to and perfectly safe!! Americans can get a Visa and stay at an AirBnb with no problems. It’s so easy to travel there. One of our best vacations.

reviews.title: Most beautiful beach
reviews.text: Warm , clear sea , fantastic long sandy beach . Perfect :) We rented cabanas most days to chill and provide shade when we were not splashing around in the sea and as a perfect place to chill with a drink.

reviews.title: top beach in the world
reviews.text: Warm turquoise water and the softest powder sand beaches makes this one of the finest beaches in the world.  And I have been to beaches in the Philippines, Thailand, Hawaii, and many other Caribean paradises.  Another huge plus?  not crowded.

reviews.title: Grand Memories Varadero Cuba
reviews.text: Fantastic resort with lots of things to do and Great staff and of course my new best friend Yoelvis.

reviews.title: A lovely family holiday
reviews.text: We needed to get away for some winter sunshine.  I had always wanted to take my son there.  I was so happy when he said he would come with us.  It was just what the Dr ordered, beautiful white sandy beaches that go on for miles, and crystal clear waters.  We would go for long walks either early in the morning or just before sundown.  We would meet locals wanting to give us shells that they had pulled out of the sea, unfortunately we were not able to accept them .  These were  in exchange for anything we could offer.I had already explained to my family how things were in Cuba, so we had taken only clothes and belongings we were prepared to part with, so when we told the Cuban's we had things to give them we would arrange to meet them just before we left and handed over clothes, shoes and toiletries, to people whose need was greater than ours.I also really wanted my son to experience this and be a happy participant.

reviews.title: Cuban 5 star experience?
reviews.text: I think I am being more than fair at 3 stars .The setting and welcome was great until our original butler was replaced in about half an hour.Yes you get a butler here, sounds good! Hmmm! Our butler seemed  more like a government spy popping up from behind trees in cupboards, everywhere ,ok ,yes if you leave us alone!or maybe you could do something like a butler would ,pour my bath polish my shoes maybe ,couldn’t even take our cases to our room.If you can’t do it don’t offer it.    Rooms and settings where great ,road nearby I could watch various 1950’s car passing pretty much constant my kind of heaven.    Food was a bit hit and miss cooked ok,a bit disconcerting when a Cuban sparrow is perch on the salad bowl every day ,they do run out of bread and bits and bobs as expected in a country Where there are trade embargoes, but this is Cuba ,you do get that feeling that this is what Jeremy Corbyn would love for the Uk 🇬🇧.The beach is and ocean is probably the best I have bathed in anywhere.5 star beach.   Night time bar was ok but humidity was a big problem for me uncomfortable. Cuba is a must place to visit while it’s in a place of stasis though 5 stars for this although the locals won’t agree ,visit Havana for 3 days first, then an hotel like this but better.

But for me personally, Shoal Bay Beach is # 1 by all standards in The island of Anguilla. We return every year.  Depends on what you are looking for and accustomed to. You can peer down the water with a clarity like you’ve never seen. Water is like glass. Hardly ever have waves.

reviews.title: Beautiful, clean, non-commercial beaches for miles
reviews.text: Varadero beaches, for the most part, have a gradual incline into the water, and it slowly gets deep as you wade in. It's quite warm and the is very little current or undertow (relative to say..Acapulco, or Cancun) The sand is soft and safe for bare feet.That being said, if you like to go for long walks, bring swim shoes. As you reach the rocky sections at the peak of each bay, you will find sharp rocks and sea urchins in the shallows. Both can hurt your feet.Also, if you like long walks, bring a drybag with sunscreen, water, footware, hat/swimshirt and some $ CUC, and a snack. The water and sunscreen are probably the most important. A drybag will let you wade in an keep your phone or whatever dry. Cash will let you take a taxi or public bus back if you need.

reviews.title: Beautiful beaches
reviews.text: The water is clear and shallow and therefore warm. Stay under water up to your shoulders to avoid sun burning and subsequent peeling, if staying in the water for a long time.

reviews.title: A great area to have a family beach holiday

You’ll need to decide what you want from your hotel, but if you are looking for a good beach and a crystal-clear sea, you won’t be disappointed.

reviews.title: So Glad We Went!!
reviews.text: My husband and I had not planned to go to Varadero, because we were under the impression that it was too far away from Havana, too expensive a taxi ride and maybe not worth it. Luckily we were convinced by everybody that we were mistaken. They were right!!! A taxi hired by our casa, one of the official yellow cabs with great air conditioning was comfortable and safe. I think we paid to have him all day and maybe paid $200. Probably less. When we saw the beach, we were speechless. It was gorgeous. We had faith in the driver who said we could leave all our valuables with him, so all we took were our towels, leant to us from our Casa. We spent about 2 hours frolicking in the crystal clear calm water. There were only like 5 people on the beach, all Cubans, since this beach was a public park. When we went back to the street, our driver was waiting under a tree in a small cafe. Since we hadn't taken our telephones with us, we had not taken any photos. Because of this, my husband ran back and captured beautiful views of the beach for posterity. We highly recommend going to Varadero by taxi. Once in a lifetime-

reviews.title: Beautiful Beach but Not Enough Beds & Construction Work Being Done
reviews.text: Spent time on Varadero beach whilst staying at Sol Palmeras.  It’s a beautiful beach with clear waters. As part of the all inclusive at the hotel there’s a snack bar serving burgers, chips, Bbq shrimps & paella, although the paella is mainly veggie. The bar also has cocktails, water, juices etc. The staff are very friendly & helpful. Currently on the beach is a huge digger/tractor with a large black pipe going into the water. I believe they are bringing more sand onto the beach although not entirely sure. This is an eyesore on the beautiful beach. I don’t know logistics of this but would have thought it better to do this work during low season perhaps September/October?? We’ve been here for 1 week & tried many times to get sun beds without success, I think people book them very early in the morning I heard as early as 6am. There are not really enough beds to cater for the amount of tourists. However the beach is beautiful & pedal boats, canoes are included as part of the all inclusive. Only reason I’m giving it 3 stars is because of the digger/work being done on the beach right now.

reviews.title: Great beach town with a slight Key West feel to it
reviews.text: My wife and I stayed in a very comfortable apartment here for two days.  We arrived from Havana by charter/tour bus and were dropped off about 10 blocks (don't worry they're short blocks) from our apartment. After walking the 10 blocks, unpacking and changing clothes, we headed directly for the beach, about 2 blocks away.  Wow! What a beautiful white sugar sand beach.  The waters are beautiful and refreshing. It's been a really long time since I spent so much time actually in the water at a beach.  On Tuesday (our first day here)  there was hardly anyone on the beach, but on Wednesday, which was a Cuban holiday equivalent to Labor Day in the U.S., there was a much larger crowd but still not overly saturated. Drinking is allowed on the beach but life guards are virtually non existant.  While trash cans are plentiful street side at the beach and the many bars, cafes, and restaurants, there are almost none actually on the beach.  People just drop their trash (mostly beer cans) and go.  After a relaxing afternoon, dinner and a walk around town a friendly local directed to the party spot, Calle 62.  We had passed this bar earlier and noticed the side street (62nd Street/Calle 62) was blocked off and was being set up for a steet party and food fair of some sort.  Upon our return we were able to quickly fill the seats of a couple that were leaving the packed establishment.  The very good singers who got the audience on stage and involved  and also a couple of very good cabaret shows.  The side of the bulding has roll up doors, so the view from the curb and street was unobstructed except for a couple of colmns.  We had the best time ever and didn't leave until arount 1:30 in the morning.

reviews.title: Cuba's Spectacular Jewel
reviews.text: The long stretch of beach in Varadero is perhaps one of the most beautiful beaches in the world!  Water is crystal clear, the beach is white sand and seemingly endless, and of course, the Cuban culture adds to the charm of this most amazing place.  When visiting, please respect the beauty of this pristine beach.  Don't spoil it with littered cigarette butts and discarded plastic cups in the sand......there are plenty of garbage cans to keep the beach clean.  Remember that you are a guest, in a country that has its own issues to deal with......please don't add to their difficulties.  Embrace the waves,  absorb the culture, dream in the most amazing sunsets, and be respectful of the beauty that warmly welcomed you.

The sun was glistening, the water was extra salty (in the best way) and the breeze was so calming. We were able to rent two lounge chairs and an umbrella for only 7 CUCs. What a steal. The only negative I have is 1. The place closed too early in the day, around 4p and 2. The bathroom/changing area  felt like a hole in the wall with hardly any light. Not to mention that toilet paper is rationed out.Nonetheless, soaking my bones in that water was glorious. If this was my back yard, I’d start aging backwards.

reviews.title: Great shoreline
reviews.text: Soft white sand walking east from Xanadu all along the shore, a brief climb at the stairs and along a rocky outcrop, then back to beach sand at Sol Palmeras resort. More Rocky outcrops after this and forced off the beach by security next resort. Further along sand starts again and continues past Las Antillas up to Royalton. At this point more coarse sand begins with some sharp shells mixed in. We took beach shoes for the rough bits. At times there's a strong  undertow all along Varadero beach. If the wind is up the waves will knock you flat. Flag system is a good warning and clearly posted.

reviews.title: Paradise!
reviews.text: A long stretch of white sand beach with clear blue water and no crowds. It is paradise! I pray this beach remains untouched and not turned into some very touristy destination where hotels would front it. I like how it is now where you can just go and enjoy a piece of paradise without having to be checked-in to a resort. I heard there is a beachfront hotel there but I didn't see it from where we were. People seemed scattered enough which was nice. This public beach features huts where you can find shade under as well as lounge chairs you can rent for a minimal fee from this local dude I like to remember as Marcelo. It could be his real name but I forget. It was safe for us to leave our belongings while we would go in the water for a swim because he would assure us he's guarding them. He was really nice and entertaining which made our stay here in Varadero beach even more memorable. He makes a good pina colada so make sure you help the guy out as he tries to make an honest living. I would steer clear from the food though. He orders it at a restaurant nearby so can't blame him but the fried pork was tough and tasteless as rubber.Public restrooms are available across the street from the beach but I didn't get to use it as they close at 5PM. Good thing I was dry enough for the 3-hour car ride back to Havana. However, if I really had to, there was a small hotel nearby which had a bar and restaurant with wifi available.The pre-paid cards can be bought from a small shed across from it for 1 CUC. Back to the beach, if I ever go back to Cuba, it will be because of this gem. This was without a doubt my favorite part of this trip.

reviews.title: great beach

reviews.title: Excellent long, clean sandy beach, clean ocean water

reviews.title: Beaches amazing

reviews.title: Beautiful beach

reviews.title: A picture turned Reality
reviews.text: Varadero Beach in Cuba is truly the most picturesque beach I have seen in the world thus far. It truly is a picture turned to reality. The days I went, March 26-30 were not the best for swimming, except the 26th, the day I arrived. The winds were far too strong and the waves were too high, all said though, we were drawn to watching the beautiful torquoise waters and walking alongside the waters. The red flags were a warning not to enter. The day I left, the 30th, the waters were calm enough to swim in. Enough said, it is truly a beautiful sight to endure. The 18th hole on the golf course close by overlooks the ocean- a golfers paradise. I intend to visit when the Cuban winter has ended, hence the stormy waters and enjoy being in Varadero Beach once more.

reviews.title: WILL DEFINITELY GO BACK
reviews.text: Outstanding beach!!!! Love Cuba and cannot wait to return.  In regards to the food we did fine. Lots of choices at the all inclusive resorts. Anywhere one travels the food is going to be different... it's all part of travelling.  People need to respect the fact that Cuba does struggle with the availability of food. The resorts do well and frankly I felt badly eating two eggs with breakfast only to learn the Cuban people are only offered 5 eggs a month for a family.  Ergo: Understand that we have access to so much and have become somewhat spoiled.  Definitely take extras with you...pack toothpaste, toothbrushes and other toiletries. The people really need it. Quite expensive for them. The Cuban  people are amazing.  Go with an open mind and realize that everything will not be like home. Hot water at our resort seemed to be available for showers when the kitchens were not washing dishes. Not  big deal. Work around it! I was concerned for the horse carts that take tourists for  rides... I  found out the horses only work two days a week while most people work 6! Haggling is ok... make sure your rides are priced correctly (Per person or for everyone)! Definitely tip... one or two pesos (Convertible currency). Take Canadian $$$ as American money is charged a 10% tax right off the top.

reviews.title: What more do you need?

reviews.title: Beautiful beaches!

reviews.title: The most beautiful beach
reviews.text: This is a lovely place, more than 60 hotels in an area of 22 Kms of white sand and blue water. A lot of restaurants, night clubs, shops and markets. The sunset can be seen from everywhere you are.

reviews.title: Beautiful beach
reviews.text: Beautiful beach you could walk forever . Lots of shells for all you collectors. White sand and a little breeze everyday. We miss this place so much all ready😎

reviews.title: Pretty Idyllic
reviews.text: Soft white sand and a gentle incline make this beach ideal for all ages. Loungers and umbrellas for hire at a couple of places, otherwise not much shade. Pretty clean and no hawkers, sand flies, or other annoyances.

reviews.title: Long Great Beach
reviews.text: The ocean is pretty warm and the sand is good.  The angle of the beach where the water meets the sand is not great so anyone with ankle issue should not have an issue if you like to take long walks.  They do rake the beach but unfortunately there are still those inconsiderate visitors that feel their garbage does not need to go in the trash barrels

reviews.title: What A Fantastic Day!!
reviews.text: We were picked up from our hotel as promised in a fantastic 1959 Chevrolet Impala by our driver Armando and our guide, Reniel.Reniel began telling us about his fantastic country immediately and never stopped all the way to Havana.  His knowledge of the history and customs of Cuba is amazing.  We were then dropped off in Havana and Reniel continued to show us the city and tell us all about it.After lunch in a great little private restaurant we then transferred to a 1954 Chevrolet Belair convertible and had an hour around Havana in that with Reniel continuing to tell us tirelessly about the city.Back to Armando in the Impala and then the return journey to our hotel in Varadero.  A fantastic, good value for money for tour, memories we will keep forever.  During the day Reniel took over 100 photos on the SD card that we had provided,  his photographic skills are as good as his knowledge!If you go to Cuba and want to see more and learn more about the country then "I LOVE CUBA TOURS" is a must.  Much better and more personal than a bus tour with another 40 or 50 people!A big thank you To Yosel who organised the tour, Reniel our brilliant guide and last but not least, Armando and his '59 Chevy!

reviews.title: wonderful

reviews.title: Awesome beach

reviews.title: Best beach
reviews.text: The beaches in Varadero are some of the best I’ve ever seen. Water is clear and beaches for miles. If you love the beach this is the place to go.

reviews.title: Varadero Beach
reviews.text: 20 km long on a narrow peninsula, Varadero Beach is Cuba's top destination beach. It is a public beach and there are 89 hotels with white crushed sand where tourists flock to every year. Shallow warm turquoise waters with rolling waves and blue skies, it was so good to escape the Canadian winter. Worth a visit

reviews.title: The Best Beach in the World
reviews.text: We visited Varadero two months ago, we had 3 days of amazing weather so there was no wave on the sea.

reviews.title: March 2019 Trip
reviews.text: By far one of the best beaches in the Caribbean! Stayed at the Sol Palmeras for the second time and will definitely go back.  Great food, service and amenities.

reviews.title: The beach in downtown Varadero is the BEST!
reviews.text: You might have stayed on the beach in the resort area of Varadero but if you are missing out if you don't take the trip into downtown Varadero and see the real beach! Hands down the most beautiful beach in the world! (Cayo Coco is a close second)

reviews.title: Untouched Beauty
reviews.text: The water was crystal clear.  The sand was like walking on clouds.  Super clean. Super soft and completely secluded.  Beautiful beach.  Unless you are staying at a resort there’s not many activities around or things to do rather than enjoy the water.  *A must visit beach to unwind and getaway.

reviews.title: Love the beach it’s always beautiful!
reviews.text: Beaches are always beautiful, with blue water and blue sky and white sand. We come to Cuba for the beaches.

reviews.title: Absolutely Beautiful
reviews.text: I’ve been to beaches throughout the Caribbean and Mexico. Varadero is the best. Clear turquoise water. Fine sand. Clean.

reviews.title: Amazing guided tour
reviews.text: My wife and I went to Cuba at the end of february and stayed in Habana for 5 days. We really wanted to see the area around the city without having to stay a night and really wanted to go to a beach. We found a guide via a company called "driving through Cuban history" who took us to Varadero beach and showed us a really good spot right on the sea front. Unbeknownst to me we were also going to have cocktails made by our guide! Such an amazing place with incredibly clear water!

reviews.title: Sand and Sea
reviews.text: This is a beautiful, wide beach with shallow, clear and warm water and clean, soft sand. There are not a lot of amenities here. Some small stores and snack shops are across the street. We paid a small fee to use the bathroom at one of the snack shops there. There was a pushcart on the road selling small but quite good pork sandwiches for $2.00 CUP. I suggest paying in exact change because they tried to give change in the national currency instead of CUP, which is worth only 1/7 of the value of CUP. They argued with me about that, and I borrowed exact change from a friend rather than let them rip me off. These were the only dishonest Cubans I met on my trip. The beach was sparsely occupied, and there was plenty of space to relax in the sand.

reviews.title: Great beach
reviews.text: Beach is beautiful.  Only issue is the cigarettes the smokers leave behind.  Amazing to see the pelicans diving for fish...

reviews.title: Simply perfect
reviews.text: Probably one of the nicest beaches. Clean, warm, waves, but not too wild. easy to go into the water.

reviews.title: Beautiful: goes on for as far as the eye can see....
reviews.text: Beautiful warm turquoise waters. Soft light sand; easy on the feet for a relaxing early morning walks or jogs. Lovely calm waters; safe for swimming, snorkeling, other water activities. Lots of marine life for underwater photography and beautiful romantic sunset photo ops.

reviews.title: VaraderoBeach  AAA+++++++
reviews.text: In my opinion, Varadaro Beach is the best I have ever seen. The water was pure blue with fine white sand.

reviews.title: Beautiful beach!
reviews.text: The best beach around! Grand Memories Sanctuary has beautiful sand and crystal clear water.  Plenty of things to do.

reviews.title: Relaxing Carribbean experience
reviews.text: Have spent lovely 10 days at The Level ( 28 Feb. - 9 Mar. 2019 ) of the hotel Melia Varadero. From the reception at arrival and throughout our stay, we were always greeted with smiles and warmth. The room, the services, food and entertainment, are all at very high level, offering what's needed for a relaxing holiday.I would like to make a special mention however, and commend, the person looking after the special section of the beach for The Level guests of the hotel - Sr. HUMBERTO REYES! A truly lovely man, very committed and devoted to his work, always there to assist in whatever required, greets everybody with a broad smile and very often a hug for those who would be there for a few days already.Sunbeds are cleaned of any remaining sand and made readily available for everybody.His daily feeding of seagulls is truly an attraction, ensuring he is on every mobile phone of the guests coming from all corners of the world.He comes across as hard working with a very open, welcoming and pleasant personality. His heart is truly on that beach. 'El Rey de la Playa' hereby deserves special commendation.Thank you for being such a good host on behalf of Melia Varadero to us, Humberto Reyes.Nikola Mihajlovicfrom Serbia

reviews.title: It really is one of the most beautiful beaches in the world
reviews.text: Nothing bad to say about Varadero beach.. long white sandy beach... and the grains of sand are even perfect -- not so small that they stick to everything but not too big that they feel like grit.The resorts are mostly not high rises so the beach is not overpowered by huge imposing resorts. Snorkling is not the best but you can take a catameran and they have a small reef where they will throw bread and you can see many fish there.There are vendors on the beach but they are not aggressive.At night you can watch the sunset... really what more can you ask!

reviews.title: Alex the Entertainer
reviews.text: We loved our time in the mornings getting ready for a full day of beach and sun which always started off with water aerobics and volleyball with Alex.

reviews.title: Simply perfect beach

The beach is simply perfect with beautiful white sand, clean warm water, no jelly fish, no hawkers selling goods and not crowded. The hotels that line this beach are set well back and in most cases are not visible from the beach.

reviews.title: Varadero
reviews.text: The water is cristal clear ! It’s a very nice beach We spent hours on the beach .even in March the water is warm!

reviews.title: One of the most beautiful beaches in the world

reviews.title: Dennis Lisa

reviews.title: Beautiful

reviews.title: Gorgeous, Clean.

reviews.title: Clean and beautiful
reviews.text: Lovely clean beach where we were (Iberostar Tainos) they have a clean the beach program for the children which is an excellent idea! Can't fault it.

reviews.title: Amazing beach
reviews.text: Clean, beautiful water and too few sun beds (but it’s not a big deal as long as you take your towel)

reviews.title: Amazing beach
reviews.text: The beach is worth the hype. Beautiful waters and white sand. Sunsets on the beach are worth waiting for

reviews.title: Best part of Varadero
reviews.text: Sounds obvious to say but Varadero doesn’t have much to offer apart from beaches. And luckily they don’t disappoint. White sands, turquoise sea and free sun loungers if you’re staying at one of the hotels in town. We really made the most of it during our visit. I ran on the beach at sunrise, swam in the sea during the day and walked along the shore at sunset. Bliss!

reviews.title: Incredible beach!!! it is so beautiful that you cannot believe it
reviews.text: it is amazing and allow you to do diff activities like, swimming, snorkling, boating or only rest in a beach with white sand and incredible view.you can bring the snorkling glasses and enjoy the fishes, corals, need only swim a few metter of shore.you not need to keep under the kids, they can play freely on the beach and the water is quite and not risk on that.

reviews.title: Most Amazing Beach!
