Very shallow and safe for kids.Very clean, groomed every night.Never feels crowded because it stretches over more than 20 km.We had mostly calm waters, one day with wind and surf, and that was fun to play in too.Lots of shade umbrellas and clean loungers,

reviews.title: Beach is well kept
reviews.text: The sand and surf are breathtakingly beautiful. The colour of the water is lime green, up to turquoise. Couldn’t look at it enough.

reviews.title: Awesome
reviews.text: Although it was chilly the first few days of our trip, we certainly enjoyed the last part of our holiday at the beach. The beach is clean, no venders as in other parts of the world. Great for walking, or just people watching. The water was warm and refreshing.

reviews.title: Nice beach but...
reviews.text: Varadero is a nice beach. It is quite clean for being in Cuba but there are many other incredible beaches and not so touristic...

reviews.title: The best beach ever
reviews.text: The beautiful beach goes on forever, the water so so clear, a beautiful turquoise. It is never crowded. Very clean.

reviews.title: Those blues and greens
reviews.text: Perfect sand, amazing colours.  Never understand why anyone would want to be poolside when this view awaits.

reviews.title: jellyfish and plastic big problems
reviews.text: very beautiful beaches, very long for walks, beautiful water but with jellyfish and plastic everywhere, many plastic cups and strong windy, they should keep it cleaner and ban plastic

reviews.title: One of the best I ever see
reviews.text: The beach is very clean, child friendly and safe with supervision. A nice small beach bar , shaded spot or beach chair available. Just few showers when leaving beach, need to have more, and also need places to have a drink or snack.

reviews.title: Beaches
reviews.text: Beaches were great. Have to get there very early to get a shaded spot or beach chair.Need more showers when leaving beach. Need to have more places to have a drink or snack. Needs improvement in these areas.

reviews.title: Heaven on Earth
reviews.text: Been to a lot of places in the world, but Varadero has the best beaches. Absolutely beautiful. Everyone should go and enjoy it.

reviews.title: Sandy and long beach
reviews.text: The beach is very safe and clean. Good for water sports and activities. Child friendly and safe with supervision.

reviews.title: Varadaro Beach Cuba
reviews.text: The beach in Varadero are the most beautiful we have ever seen or been on.  Would go back just for the beaches.

reviews.title: Beautiful beach
reviews.text: Miles of white sand, beautiful blue water.  This is our 4th time going to Varadero the weather has always been great. We go on vacation to relax and feel safe.

reviews.title: like i said,this was our 5th stay at the melia and would not trade this country and its people for any place on earth.
reviews.text: We go on vacation to relax and feel safe! and of course the ocean and its beautiful beaches.this is our 5th year at this resort and weather has been great every year! Cubans are the  most friendly people of any country that we have visited.the Melia offers you everything to make your stay special.

reviews.title: One of the best.
reviews.text: A must experience in Cuba. Fresh air and blue sky. Lovely sand, water. Great activities available. A variety of beaches available. Some more steep.

reviews.title: Stunning beach!
reviews.text: Varadero beach is absolutely beautiful!  You can walk for miles and miles.  The turquoise water is stunning.  I highly recommend visiting this beach!

reviews.title: Amazing!
reviews.text: Best beach by far. White sand. Walked every morning along the shore. So beautiful!  We will return for sure!

reviews.title: Beachy keen
reviews.text: A beautiful beach with fine sand and gorgeous blue colours. Clear waters . Ideal for water surfing , paddle boats , etc.

reviews.title: Most beautiful
reviews.text: Most beautiful beach I have ever step on to. Soft sands, turquoise water, and so warm. Some areas have less seaweed than others, however,.

reviews.title: White powder beach
reviews.text: THe sand is white and fine ( except for shell fragments here and there). The water was clear and beautiful.Though the beaches are taken care of by the differing hotels, the beaches themselves are public.  You simply can not use the chairs etc. if not staying in one of the hotels (  I was).       If in Cuba and you have the time, this is a very nice beach.

reviews.title: Very wide and so soft
reviews.text: The beach stretches for several kms and is great for beach combing.  The water is so very clear and recommend it

reviews.title: Nice beaches!
reviews.text: Nice sandy beaches, warm and clean ocean. Most front beaches are controlled by the hotels. Visited from La Habana in rental car, trip is two hours. We parked at shopping mall plaza Centro de Convenciones Plaza Americas with restaurants money exchange and access to showers.

reviews.title: Absolutely beautiful
reviews.text: What can i say about this beach? You can take as many pictures but it doesn't capture how beautiful and stunning it is.

reviews.title: beach!!!
reviews.text: beautiful crystal clear white sand beach, the issue was the stench of petroleum from the nearby refinery

reviews.title: Beautiful
reviews.text: Beautiful!!  white sand/blue water ..gorgeous!!!  We never had a problem finding a chair . We want to go back :)

reviews.title: best beach
reviews.text: nicest beach i have ever seen, water was warm and the color was a crazy blue green, could walk out forever

reviews.title: Absolutely beautiful
reviews.text: This beach is nothing short of the perfect, picturesque beach. It’s cleanliness, hot sand and beautiful clear waters are appreciated

reviews.title: Absolutly stunning.
reviews.text: The most beautiful water with gorgeous sandy beach. Beach chairs were in short supply. It was picture perfect

reviews.title: South Beach Twin
reviews.text: When we first entered   I could not see anything special about this place.  But once we made our way all the way to the end were the marina was located at the end of the road the place became very  modern with new apartment and resort buildings, and the prices which I hate to actually say this were reasonable when you consider the amount of money that has been poured into this resort area when you compare the same price too Old Havana Truth be told if you been to South Beach this is almost a carbon copy I would've personally preferred something more authentic then another view of Miami Would I go back ,  probably not as a beach town there are better places like Santa Maria which also boost a beautiful beach  Point of fact we had lunch at the marina and the cost was no more then when we ate lunch the following day in Old Havana  which was about 10-12 cuc per person

reviews.title: Great trip
reviews.text: Varadero beach is nice, most days is calm and the water is clear, bring a bun with you and you'll have lots of small fish eat right out of your hands.Great place

reviews.title: Crystal water!
reviews.text: The beach of Varadero has crystal ocean water. The sand is not so good as the sand at Sunny beach in Bulgaria and looks like construction material. On the beach it is windy and very hot. If you want to spend some time on the beach, be sure either to reserve a place before 7.00 AM or go after 15.00 PM when there are free places. During the day the sand is hot. Be sure to have a lot of sun cream and a hat.

reviews.title: Fantastic beach in paradise
reviews.text: The beach was lovely white sand and crystal clear water only a stone's throw from our hotel (Iberostar Varadero).

reviews.title: Best beach!
reviews.text: This an awesome beach and one of the best in cuba. Water is white and blue and very clean. White sand everywhere.

reviews.title: white sand!
reviews.text: the beach was clean & you can go far into the water and still have your footing. The waves was great fun and the water was warm...

reviews.title: Superb sandy beach
reviews.text: Beautiful long sandy beach with azure blue waters and activities. Mostly clear but a few rocky sections.

reviews.title: best beaches
reviews.text: In my opinion Varadero Has the best beaches there is  the sand is so white and soft just like warm snow we have stayed at 2 resorts on the varadero beaches and they are  the same very nice for walking on easy to get onto the water lots of entaintainment going and very clean

reviews.title: Beach at Melia Las Antillas
reviews.text: Beautiful, easy slope into the ocean, soft clean sand, good tilapas, normally gentle soft waves.... one of the beat.

reviews.title: Wonderful beach
reviews.text: Best beach bar none. Lots of activities and no high pressure vendors trying to get your money. Water is turquoise blue ,clean and warm! Lots of room on the beach although many get up early to reserve a spot.

reviews.title: Very clean and large natural beach
reviews.text: The beaches in Varadero must be some of the most beautiful natural, clean and well maintained I've ever seen.

reviews.title: Breathtaking
reviews.text: Those beaches in Varadero are amazing, the sea is very clear and calm. The view is breathtaking with the white sand.

reviews.title: spotlessley clean
reviews.text: Lovely fine sand and not at all packed when we went. You really need water as it gets so hot but the sea breeze can trick you!
